title: WordPress Landing Page Designer & Developer
description:
Remote | Philippines | Project-Based | Potential for Ongoing Work 



Are you a creative, detail-oriented WordPress expert who knows how to turn a great design into a landing page that actually converts?  



Zammitti Law, PLLC, a boutique estate planning and elder law firm based in New York, USA, is looking for a talented WordPress Landing Page Designer & Developer to take ownership of an exciting initial project. 



 We're looking for someone who combines strong technical skills with a creative eye, excellent communication, and a genuine sense of responsibility for the finished product. 



This is an excellent opportunity for an independent professional who enjoys creating beautiful, functional websites and wants to build a lasting relationship with a U.S.-based business. 



Our first project is one landing page. If the collaboration goes well, there is potential to develop additional landing pages and possibly redesign our existing website. 



A Little About Us 

At Zammitti Law, we help individuals, families, and business owners protect what matters most through thoughtful legal planning.  



We're a small, collaborative, client-focused team that values professionalism, creativity, initiative, and doing our best for every client every time. 



Our website and marketing materials reflect our commitment to making complex legal topics approachable, and we're looking for someone who can bring that same thoughtful approach to our digital presence. 



You can learn more about us at 
. 



What You’ll Be Doing 

You will work with our team to design, create, test, and launch a professional, conversion-focused WordPress landing page. 



Your responsibilities will include: 

- Create a visually appealing, modern landing page that reflects our brand and resonates with our intended audience. 

- Develop the landing page using WordPress, ensuring a polished experience on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. 

- Recommend improvements to layout, messaging, calls to action, and user experience to increase conversions. 

- Integrate forms, scheduling tools, tracking pixels, and other marketing tools as required. 

- Optimize loading speed, mobile responsiveness, basic SEO, and overall performance. 

- Test every element thoroughly, including forms, buttons, links, and mobile layouts. 

- Track project milestones, communicate progress, and address feedback promptly. 

- Deliver a fully functioning, thoroughly tested landing page with clear instructions for future updates. 



We will provide direction on our brand, audience, goals, and available content. We expect you to bring your technical expertise, design recommendations, and creative problem-solving skills to the project. 



What We’re Looking For 

Required qualifications 

- Demonstrated professional experience designing and developing landing pages using WordPress. 

- Strong knowledge of WordPress themes, plugins, and page builders such as Elementor, Divi, or Gutenberg. 

- A portfolio demonstrating high-quality, responsive website or landing page design. 

- Experience creating conversion-focused landing pages with compelling calls to action. 

- Strong understanding of mobile optimization, website speed, and usability. 

- Ability to troubleshoot technical problems independently. 

- Excellent written and spoken English. 

- Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills, and time management. 

- Ability to meet agreed-upon deadlines and communicate proactively. 

- Willingness to receive feedback and make thoughtful revisions. 



Preferred qualifications 

- WordPress certification or relevant professional training. 

- Experience working with U.S.-based companies. 

- Familiarity with ActiveCampaign or comparable CRM and marketing automation platforms. 

- Experience integrating contact forms, appointment scheduling, analytics, and conversion tracking. 

- Knowledge of HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript. 

- Familiarity with SEO, Google Analytics, and Meta Pixel. 

- Previous work with professional services businesses, particularly law firms, is a plus. 



 Who Will Thrive in This Role? 

You'll be a strong fit if you are: 

- Creative: You bring fresh ideas and thoughtful design recommendations. 

- Proactive: You identify potential problems and suggest solutions before being asked. 

- Detail-oriented: You notice the misaligned button, broken link, or inconsistent spacing others might overlook. 

- Accountable: You take ownership of your work and follow through on commitments. 

- Independent: You can take a clear project objective and move it forward without constant supervision. 

- Communicative: You provide updates, ask meaningful questions, and aren't afraid to offer suggestions. 

- Results-driven: You understand that a landing page needs to do more than look good. It needs to perform. 



Project Structure & Compensation 

Location: Remote, Philippines-based applicants. 

Engagement: Freelance / independent contractor, project-based. 



Initial assignment: One WordPress landing page. 

Compensation: Fixed project fee based on experience, portfolio, and proposed scope. 



Schedule: Flexible work hours, with scheduled meetings and reasonable communication overlap with our team in Eastern Time (New York). 



Future opportunities: Additional landing pages, website enhancements, and a potential full website redesign, based on the success of the initial project. 



We respect the time difference and do not expect you to work an overnight U.S. schedule. However, timely communication and availability for occasional prearranged meetings are important. 



How to Apply — PLEASE READ CAREFULLY

We're looking for professionals who pay close attention to details and follow instructions. 

Please
 
 with the exact subject line: Pixel Perfect & Project-Ready 



Your application must include: 

- Your current resume or CV, highlighting your WordPress experience and any relevant certifications or training. 

- At least THREE samples of your work, preferably live links to landing pages or websites you personally designed or developed. Briefly describe your contribution to each project. 

- THREE professional references, including their names, professional relationships to you, and contact information. 

- Your proposed fixed project fee in USD for a typical single-page WordPress landing page, along with your standard hourly rate for additional work. Final pricing will be agreed upon after reviewing the project requirements. 

- A brief introduction of no more than three paragraphs explaining your WordPress experience, your approach to designing an effective landing page, and why you would be a great fit for our team. 



Important: Applications missing the required subject line, portfolio samples, references, or compensation information will not be considered. 



One Great Project Could Be Just the Beginning 

We're not looking for someone to simply put together a page and disappear. We're hoping to find a talented, dependable professional who takes pride in their work and enjoys collaborating with a growing U.S. business. 



If you are a skilled WordPress designer and developer who is creative, organized, responsive, and committed to delivering exceptional results, we'd love to see what you can do. 



Show us your best work, tell us what you bring to the table, and let's see what we can build together.

Do you enjoy turning detailed information into clear, professional designs? Can you bring a consistent look to product brochures,

Intriquip Instruments Inc. supplies and services veterinary equipment for customers across Canada. We are looking for an experienced designer in the Philippines to work with our Marketing Manager, Aaron, and collaborate with our marketing researcher and product specialists.

WHAT YOU WILL DO



• Design
 campaign visuals, product literature, website pages, blog graphics and tradeshow materials.

• Create reusable templates and practical visual standards that keep our materials consistent.

• Prepare print-ready artwork and organised, editable source files.

• Build approved website and
 layouts using visual editors, checking desktop and mobile presentation.

• Improve the visual design of
 and quotation templates in Odoo, collaborating with a developer where coding is required.

• Support design and page assembly if we migrate our website to Odoo in the future.

• Manage agreed deadlines, communicate obstacles early and respond constructively to feedback.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



• A strong portfolio demonstrating typography, layout, visual hierarchy and consistency across formats.

• Experience with product literature or other detailed documents, printed materials and website/email layouts.

• Confidence using professional design tools such as Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop, Figma or comparable tools.

• Ability to create editable templates and hand over files another team member can update.

• Basic experience implementing designs in website or
 builders.

• Good written and spoken English, careful attention to detail and reliable follow-through.

• Willingness to learn unfamiliar products and software.



Odoo experience and basic HTML/CSS are advantages, but are not required. Advanced development will be handled with a developer. Veterinary industry experience is not required.



HOW WE WORK



This is an ongoing contractor opportunity for approximately 20 hours per week. Most production hours can be flexible, with agreed weekly meetings and review times.



You will receive direction, product information and feedback from our team. We also want you to question unclear briefs, suggest improvements and explain your design decisions.



Our core values are:

• Be Compassionate

• Be a Learner

• Help First

• Do The Right Thing

• Be Humbly Confident



HOW TO APPLY



Use the subject: “Intriquip Designer – [Your Name]”



Please include:



1. Your CV and portfolio link.



2. Three relevant examples: a detailed document or brochure, a website/email layout, and a print piece. Examples may overlap categories. If you lack one category, tell us.



For each example, briefly explain the audience, your personal contribution, one important design decision and the tools used. Identify any contributions from teammates, existing templates, stock assets or AI.



3. A brief example of design feedback that substantially changed your work and how you handled it.



4. An example of learning unfamiliar software, and how you would approach your first assignment in Odoo.



5. Your expected monthly rate for approximately 20 hours/week, current availability, earliest start date and availability for meetings in Philippine time.



Shortlisted candidates will have a portfolio interview. Finalists will complete a short, paid design assessment using the same supplied brief, followed by a discussion of their work.



We assess design judgment, accuracy, communication, learning ability and response to feedback. We do not require free custom design work with your application.

title: Inside Sales Representative
description:
Are you the type of salesperson who loves closing deals, hates leaving money on the table, and knows how to turn a “let me think about it” into a booked job? We want you on our team!



JT is looking for a driven, confident, and highly organized Inside Sales Representative who knows how to sell over the phone. We're not looking for someone who simply answers inquiries and sends quotes. We need someone who takes ownership of every lead, follows up consistently, handles objections, and turns potential customers into paying customers.



If you enjoy talking to people, chasing opportunities, hitting targets, and seeing your hard work translate into results, this could be the perfect role for you.



What You'll Be Doing

Close sales over the phone. Turn inbound inquiries into booked jobs by building rapport, asking the right questions, presenting solutions, and confidently asking for the sale.

Move fast on new leads. Contact new inquiries within 5 minutes whenever possible. Speed matters, and we don't want good leads going cold.

Follow up like a pro. Call, text, and reconnect with customers who haven't booked yet. One call is rarely enough, and you'll know when to keep the conversation going.

Turn estimates into sales. Follow up on open quotes, address concerns, overcome price objections, and help customers make a decision.

Manage a busy pipeline. Keep track of new leads, callbacks, text conversations, pending estimates, and scheduled jobs without letting opportunities slip through the cracks.

Keep the CRM updated. Record accurate notes, track every conversation, and make sure every lead has a clear next step.

Coordinate with the team. Help customers with scheduling, answer questions, and ensure a smooth experience from the first call to the booked job.

Hit your numbers. Work toward daily sales goals, strong conversion rates, and consistent performance.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for a salesperson first, not just a customer service representative.



You might be a great fit if you:

Have 2–5+ years of experience in inside sales, telesales, appointment setting, or phone-based sales.

Are comfortable spending most of your workday making and receiving calls.

Know how to handle objections, discuss pricing, and confidently ask customers to buy.

Don't give up after one unanswered call or one “not right now.”

Can manage multiple conversations and tasks without losing track of important details.

Are comfortable using CRMs, phone systems, text messaging platforms, and scheduling tools.

Communicate in clear, natural, professional English.

Take ownership of your results and don't need someone constantly reminding you what to do.

Are competitive, coachable, organized, and motivated by hitting targets.

Can take feedback, participate in call reviews, and work on improving your sales skills.

Experience in home services is a plus, but it's not required. If you've sold HVAC services, roofing, plumbing, cleaning services, insurance, automotive services, memberships, or other consumer services over the phone, we'd love to hear from you.



We can teach you our services and systems. What we can't teach as easily is the drive to pick up the phone, follow up, and close the deal.



What Success Looks Like

We want someone who takes every lead seriously and understands that every missed follow-up could mean a missed sale.



Here are the results we're working toward:



New leads contacted in under 5 minutes whenever possible.

A target booking/close rate of 50% or higher.

Consistent follow-up on every open estimate and sales opportunity.

A meaningful contribution toward JT's daily sales goal of $20,000+.

Accurate CRM records and a pipeline where no lead gets forgotten.

These are performance targets, not guarantees. Your ability to consistently execute, learn, and improve will matter.



What This Job Is NOT

Let's be clear about a few things.



This is not a passive customer service role where you answer questions and wait for the next call.

This is not a job where you send a quote and hope the customer gets back to you.

This is not a fit for someone who dislikes making outbound calls or following up multiple times.

This is not a role for someone who needs constant supervision to stay productive.

Some customers will say no. Some won't answer. Some will push back on price. That's part of sales. We need someone who stays professional, keeps moving, and knows how to create opportunities instead of waiting for them.



Why Join JT?

Work remotely from home.

Be part of a team that values initiative, accountability, and results.

Develop your phone sales, objection-handling, and closing skills.

Have clear performance goals so you know what success looks like.

Get the opportunity to make a real impact on the company's growth.

title: AI Video Editor – Professional Video Enhancement for Online Courses
description:
I’m looking for an experienced AI-assisted Video Editor to professionally enhance a series of prerecorded educational videos for an online course.



The videos are approximately 5–15 minutes long and primarily feature me speaking directly to the camera.



The goal is to transform my existing recordings into clean, polished, premium-quality educational videos.



IMPORTANT: I do NOT want the videos to look AI-generated.



I want natural, realistic enhancements that make the videos look as though they were recorded in a professional studio.



Responsibilities

1. Video Quality Enhancement



Improve lighting, brightness, contrast, and color.

Enhance overall video sharpness and clarity.

Maintain natural skin tones and facial features.

Improve framing and visual consistency.

2. Background Enhancement



Clean up or professionally replace existing backgrounds when necessary.

Create realistic, elegant, professional-looking backgrounds.

Ensure lighting, shadows, and edges look natural.

Avoid artificial, unrealistic, or obviously AI-generated environments.

3. Audio Enhancement



Remove background noise and distractions.

Improve voice clarity and audio quality.

Ensure consistent sound levels throughout each video.

4. Professional Video Editing



Remove unnecessary pauses, mistakes, and awkward cuts.

Create smooth, natural transitions.

Maintain a consistent editing style across the entire course series.

Add subtle professional touches where appropriate without overediting.

What I Do NOT Want

AI-generated avatars or replacement presenters

Changes to my face, facial expressions, or body

Artificial-looking skin or excessive beauty filters

Unrealistic AI backgrounds

Excessive animations or distracting effects

Videos that look fake, heavily filtered, or overproduced

The finished videos must still look and sound like ME—just professionally recorded and edited.



Project Details

Video type: Online educational course series

Average length: 5–15 minutes per video

Format: Talking-head / educational videos

Style: Clean, natural, elegant, and professional

Delivery: High-quality MP4 files

Opportunity for additional projects if the initial collaboration is successful

Requirements

Experience with professional talking-head video editing

Strong skills in AI-assisted video enhancement

Experience with realistic background replacement

Excellent lighting and color correction skills

Audio cleanup and enhancement experience

Strong attention to detail

Ability to deliver consistent quality across multiple videos

Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Topaz Video AI, Runway, Descript, CapCut, or similar tools is welcome.



How to Apply

Please reply to this job posting by
 with the following information:



Your WhatsApp phone number, including your country code.

Examples of your previous work, preferably before-and-after video enhancements.

Examples of realistic AI background replacements, if available.

Your price per video for 5–15-minute recordings.

Your usual turnaround time per video.

The software or AI tools you use.

Applications without a portfolio and WhatsApp contact number will not be considered.



After reviewing applications, I will contact shortlisted candidates via WhatsApp and send them a short sample video for a paid editing test.



The test will help me evaluate your ability to improve video quality, lighting, audio, and background while keeping the result completely natural.



Candidates who produce the best results may be selected to edit the entire course series.



I’m looking for someone reliable, detail-oriented, reasonably priced, and capable of producing beautiful, professional videos without making them look artificially generated.

title: Master Scheduler & Logistics Associate
description:
Join Our Team as a Master Scheduler & Logistics Associate!

At our core, we believe that a great product is only as good as the experience of receiving it. We

are looking for an orchestrator—someone who can bridge the gap between production planning

and final delivery to ensure our premium gaming tables reach our customers swiftly and with

surgical precision.



About Us

Founded in 2006, Uniworld Omniport is a direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce company that

owns and operates two industry-leading brands: BBO Poker Tables and Game Theory Tables.

Based at the Speedway in North East Las Vegas, our global presence connects team members

from around the world, united by our mission to "create unforgettable memories between friends

and family." At the core of our internal culture are trust and accountability, values that are

evident in the actions of our team members.



Why This Role Matters:

You are the heartbeat of our operations. By owning the integration of production scheduling and

freight booking, you directly impact our brand reputation. You ensure that every "BBO Poker

Table" and "Game Theory Table" moves seamlessly from a build plan to a customer’s home,

eliminating friction and boosting productivity across the entire organization.



How Success is Measured in This Role:

We believe in transparency and data-driven growth. Your success will be evaluated through:

- On-Time Performance: Meeting or exceeding delivery service level agreement with the

customer consistently.

- Accuracy Rates: Ensuring fulfillment and booking accuracy are near-perfect.

- Cost Efficiency: Identifying and securing optimal freight rates to balance quality and

cost.



The Perfect Teammate We Need:

- The Orchestrator: You have a knack for creating master schedules that account for

inventory, staffing, and capacity constraints.

- The Communicator: You can collaborate across departments—from Sales and

Customer Service to the local dispatch team—to keep everyone aligned.

- The Detail-Obsessive: You take pride in the Quality Check process, validating every

accessory, color, and customization to ensure order completeness.

- The Strategic Thinker: You don't just follow a process; you audit SOPs and update

scheduling logic based on seasonal trends and business goals.



What You’ll Deliver:

- Daily Flow: Update build lists, conduct shipping coordination meetings, and generate

Bills of Lading (BOL).

- Logistics Mastery: Secure freight bookings, track orders proactively, and manage

overflow needs with the Product Operations Manager.

- Strategic Planning: Participate in quarterly KPI "Deep Dives" and contribute to annual

production and logistics strategies.

- Visibility: Provide real-time updates and shared production SLAs to ensure

stakeholders always know where an order stands.



Why Work With Us?

You aren't just a gear in a machine; you are the one designing how the machine runs. You will

have a seat at the table during strategic planning meetings, influence our shipping vendor

partnerships, and play a pivotal role in the expansion of two premier gaming brands.

title: Real Estate Cold Caller
description:
🚀 NOW HIRING: 5 ELITE COLD CALLERS | REAL ESTATE | PERFORMANCE-DRIVEN

We're not looking for average. We're looking for HUNGRY.

Company: Titan Home Buyers

Position: Real Estate Cold Caller

Location: Remote — Philippines

Openings: 5 Full-Time Positions

Schedule: 40 Hours Per Week | Weekend Availability Is a Plus (Not Required)

Monthly Base Compensation: $520 USD/mo

Experience: Preferred, NOT Required



READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING.

Let's get one thing straight.

This is NOT a job for someone who just wants to clock in, make a few calls, and collect a paycheck.

We're building a team of high-performing individuals who are hungry to win, willing to put in the work, and serious about producing results.

We're looking for people who have the discipline to show up every day, the confidence to lead conversations, and the resilience to keep pushing when things get difficult.

You will hear "NO."

You will deal with rejection.

You will speak with frustrated homeowners.

You will have days when it feels like nobody wants to talk.

And guess what? You still have to show up and perform.

If rejection destroys your confidence, this probably isn't the role for you.

But if you're competitive, coachable, disciplined, and motivated by results, keep reading.



🎯 THE MISSION

Your job is simple: Find motivated homeowners, have meaningful conversations, identify qualified opportunities, and hand off those leads to our acquisitions team. 

You are the first point of contact between our company and potential sellers.

We don't need robots reading scripts.

We need confident communicators who know how to listen, ask intelligent questions, build rapport, and uncover genuine seller motivation.

You won't be responsible for negotiating or closing deals.

Your job is to create opportunities. And create them consistently.



🔥 WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU

Relentless consistency: Show up ready to perform every single day, even when yesterday didn't go your way.

Thick skin: Handle rejection, objections, and difficult conversations without losing your composure.

A competitive mindset: Set high standards for yourself and continuously look for ways to improve.

Persistence with professionalism: Don't fold at the first objection. Stay curious, ask better questions, and know when to respectfully move on.

Extreme accountability: Take ownership of your numbers, your performance, and your results. No excuses. No blaming the leads.

Integrity: Be honest in every conversation, accurately report your activity, and never fabricate or misrepresent a lead.

Coachability: Accept feedback, apply what you learn, and actively work to sharpen your skills.

Long-term commitment: We're looking for people who want to grow alongside the business, not just fill a seat.



📊 HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS

We're not impressed by activity alone. We're impressed by productive activity that generates REAL opportunities.

Making hundreds of calls means very little if those calls aren't producing meaningful conversations and qualified leads.

Your performance will be evaluated based on:

1. Meaningful Conversations

How consistently are you connecting with homeowners and having productive, genuine conversations?

2. Lead Quality

Are you identifying homeowners with real selling interest, genuine motivation, and a potential need for our services?

3. Qualified Appointments

How consistently are you generating legitimate, qualified seller opportunities for our acquisitions team?

4. Consistency & Productivity

Can you deliver results consistently rather than having one great day followed by a week of excuses?

5. Accountability & Improvement

Are you following the process, accepting coaching, maintaining accurate records, and improving your performance?

Our ultimate measure of success is the quality and consistency of the qualified seller opportunities you generate.

We value RESULTS, not just effort.



💪 WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You might be a great fit if:

You're naturally competitive and hate settling for average.

You're self-motivated and don't need someone constantly checking whether you're working.

You can handle hearing "no" repeatedly without getting discouraged.

You know how to turn objections into productive conversations.

You communicate confidently, clearly, and professionally.

You take pride in doing what you say you're going to do.

You're hungry to learn, improve, and become exceptional at your craft.

You want to be part of a growing company where your contributions actually matter.

Previous cold-calling, sales, or real estate experience is a PLUS, but NOT required.

We'll take someone with ZERO experience and an exceptional work ethic over someone with five years of experience and a terrible attitude.

Skills can be taught. Hunger, discipline, and integrity have to come from YOU.



❌ THIS POSITION IS NOT FOR YOU IF:

You're just looking for an easy paycheck.

You need constant supervision to stay productive.

You give up after hearing a few objections.

You make excuses instead of taking accountability.

You're uncomfortable with repetitive work.

You resist coaching or constructive criticism.

You prioritize looking busy over producing results.

You aren't willing to put in consistent effort to improve.



🚀 WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US

We're building something bigger than just a cold-calling operation.

Our goal is to develop a team of dependable, high-performing professionals who take pride in their work and grow with the company.

You'll receive:

Training and guidance to help you succeed.

Clear expectations and measurable performance standards.

Ongoing coaching and constructive feedback.

An environment where initiative, integrity, and results are recognized.

The opportunity to grow alongside an expanding real estate investment company.

When the company grows, we want our best performers growing with it.





🏆 THE BOTTOM LINE

We're hiring FIVE individuals who are ready to take this opportunity seriously.

Not five people who simply want a job.

Five people who want to COMPETE.

Five people who want to IMPROVE.

Five people who take PRIDE in their performance.

Five people who are willing to do the repetitive, uncomfortable work that separates top performers from everyone else.

You don't have to be the best cold caller today. But you MUST be committed to becoming one.

If that's you, we want to hear from you.



📩 HOW TO APPLY

To be considered, submit your application along with a short voice recording (30–60 seconds) answering the following:

1. Why do you believe you'd excel in a performance-driven cold-calling role?

2. How do you handle rejection when you've heard "no" all day?

3. What makes you different from someone who just wants to clock in and collect a paycheck?

We're not looking for perfect answers.

We're looking for confidence, hunger, authenticity, and the right attitude.

Think you have what it takes? PROVE IT.

Titan Home Buyers — Where Performance, Integrity, and Consistency Matter.

title: Full-Time Remote Editor
description:
Skilled CapCut / TikTok Editor (Clone + Green Screen Content) — PH Time Zone



Looking for a PROFESSIONAL short-form editor to produce TikTok videos for a high-performing page. This is not basic talking-head trimming. A large share of the work is multi-clone videos and green-screen edits that need precise compositing, timing, and audio.



You can use CapCut or another editor you are fast and accurate in.



What the work actually involves

Many videos require real editing skill and close attention to detail, including:

- Clone videos: background removal, placing multiple clones on one background, even spacing, and natural conversation timing so clones do not talk over each other or leave awkward gaps

- Green-screen videos: clean keying, background removal, and accurate image/asset placement

- Selecting the strongest take for each line or clone

- Audio overlays so cuts between clips have no pops, hard cuts, or dead air

- Dynamic zooms, crops, and on-screen text (including sizing/callout text as in the reference videos)

- Clean talking-head assembly when a video is simpler



Please review a few examples of my content so you know the style before applying:



1. Talking head with overlays — tight cuts plus images placed on screen to support what is being said.


 



2. Clone video — multiple versions of the same person on one background. Needs clean background removal, even clone placement/spacing, and dialogue timed like a real conversation (no talking over each other, no awkward pauses).


  



3. Green screen video — clean keying, background removal, and accurate image/background placement so the subject sits naturally in the scene.


 



You will work directly with me on a page that already gets strong reach. On-time delivery and videos that perform can earn bonuses, with room to grow hours and pay.



Requirements

- Proven skill with short-form editing (portfolio or sample required)

- Clean background removal / keying and multi-layer clone placement

title: Appointment Setter B2B — $1,200 US per month + $50 per show-up
description:
Please just send us any message if you're interested, and we will send you a Google Form. All applications will be considered through the form.

Why strong setters join us

We built a role where your results are directly reflected in what you earn — with a guaranteed base, clear performance bonuses, and a team that genuinely invests in your growth. If you're experienced, consistent, and take your craft seriously, this is a place where you can build something real.

01 — Uncapped earning potential



Your compensation grows with your performance. The structure is transparent, the targets are achievable, and there's no ceiling on what you can earn each month.

02 — Experienced leadership that develops you



You'll work closely with a team that knows this business inside and out. We share what's working, coach on what isn't, and help you sharpen your skills continuously — tone, objection handling, and conversation flow.

03 — A supportive, high-performing team



We hold a high standard here, and we support each other in reaching it. You'll be working alongside people who are serious about their work and their growth.



Compensation — paid every week via Wise

Base salary: $1,200 USD/month — guaranteed



Per qualified appointment (showed up): $50 USD — every one, on top of the base



Working hours



9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Eastern Time (ET)



That is 10:00 PM – 6:30 AM Philippine Time (PHT).

This is a night shift role. We are fully transparent about that. There is a strong and experienced community of Filipino professionals who work US hours — if that's you, and you're comfortable with it, the compensation reflects the commitment.



Onboarding



Your first 10 days are structured onboarding. We walk you through everything — the script, the CRM, and the process — until you feel fully confident.

To join the core team, the target during onboarding is a minimum of 3 qualified appointments. This is a realistic and achievable bar, and we'll be coaching you throughout to help you get there.



What you'll actually do



Make 150–200 outbound cold calls per day to businesses that may need commercial janitorial services.

Identify genuine needs and book qualified appointments for businesses ready to receive a cleaning quote.

Deliver a proven script naturally and conversationally — not mechanically.

Keep your pipeline and call logs updated accurately in our CRM each day.

Receive ongoing coaching and access to the strategies that have proven to work.





Who we're looking for



2+ years in B2B sales or outbound cold calling.

A natural, professional phone presence — you sound like a consultant, not a caller.

Ability to internalize a script and deliver it as a real conversation.

Stable setup: 80+ Mbps internet, a reliable computer, and a quality headset.

Comfortable navigating a CRM independently — logging calls, updating records, and managing your pipeline.





What you're walking into



A company with a clear system, transparent compensation, and leadership that takes your development seriously. You'll know exactly what's expected, exactly what you'll earn, and exactly how to grow. We want people who stay, improve, and build with us long term.

Ready to apply?



If this sounds like the right fit, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply with any message and we will send you a Google form to fill out.

title: Full-Stack Product Engineer — Mobile & Web
description:
This position works closely with product, design, and engineering to build reliable user facing features across mobile and web. The Full Stack Product Engineer will help create and maintain consistent experiences in the FYND iOS and Android application and website, connect those experiences to shared application programming interfaces, and support products that help students discover career and education opportunities. 



RESPONSIBILITIES 

* Build and maintain features for the iOS and Android application using React Native, Expo, and TypeScript. 

* Build and improve website features using React, TypeScript, and Vite. 

* Connect mobile and web experiences to the shared application programming interface and maintain a consistent experience across platforms. 

* Work with backend services built with Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL. 

* Improve application reliability, accessibility, performance, usability, and overall quality. 

* Write and maintain tests, investigate and resolve bugs, and participate in code reviews. 

* Collaborate with product and design to translate user needs into practical, maintainable features. 

* Support the release, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance of features used by customers. 



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

* Experience building applications with React and TypeScript. 

* Demonstrated ability to ship, support, and maintain user facing application features. 

* Production mobile development experience, ideally with React Native and Expo, or comparable experience with the ability to work effectively in Expo. 

* Experience building and integrating REST application programming interfaces. 

* Familiarity with testing, debugging, and maintaining software used by real customers. 

* Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions clearly. 



HELPFUL EXPERIENCE 

* Experience with Node.js and Express. 

* Experience with PostgreSQL and an object relational mapping tool such as Drizzle. 

* Experience with Expo Router, React Query, or OpenAPI generated application programming interface clients. 

* Experience with mobile application releases, authentication, notifications, file uploads, or accessibility. 

* Interest in education, career development, or products that help students find opportunities. 



ROLE PRIORITIES 

The strongest candidates will bring solid React and TypeScript experience, demonstrated success shipping and maintaining application features, and meaningful mobile development experience. React Native and Expo experience is strongly preferred for this cross platform role. 



Experience with FYND specific backend tools and libraries, including Express, PostgreSQL, Drizzle, React Query, and OpenAPI, is helpful but can be learned on the job. A particular degree is not required. The focus is on practical engineering ability, reliable execution, and effective collaboration with the team and its shared application programming interface. 



SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS: Owns a laptop or a desktop computer that can do basic research, operate website and
 platforms. Internet with at least 100mbps speed. 



WORKING CONDITIONS: Candidate can work from anywhere, with reliable internet access. They must be able to communicate in a clear and prompt manner. It is a full-time position with 40 hours per week. There will be daily communications with team members in the Philippines and the US. Half of the work time will be on the US time schedule and the other half of the work hours are flexible.  



SALARY & BENEFITS: $800 USD/month 

* Growth Opportunities  

* Flexible Scheduling  

* BONUS opportunities after a 90 day probationary period (15 paid days annual leave, 10 paid holidays, and a QUARTERLY benefit opportunity of $170 USD, HMO budget worth ₱15,000) 



At STEM 101, we are building technology that helps students discover where their interests and abilities can lead. We hope this position helps create a reliable and accessible experience that connects more students with meaningful opportunities.

title: Virtual Executive Assistant
description:
I'm the founder of a digital growth marketing company that helps mission-driven founders scale their businesses with more ease & less overwhelm - and I'm looking for a small team of highly-skilled Executive Assistants to help take over the marketing and management tasks that make a huge difference in the lives of the people that hire us.



I'm looking for a max of 5 amazing executive assistants available for part-time (potential for full time) with a salary starting at $500 USD per month and with long term success and robust training, moving up to $700 USD per month as an emerging leader in the company.



If you have the following skill sets, I encourage you to apply:



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

- Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Video Editing, Social Media Management, Content Creation, and Executive Assistant Work (Administrative Tasks, Calendar &
 Management, etc)

You’re trusted to manage marketing deliverables while providing high-level executive support, keeping priorities organized, systems moving, and leadership focused on growth instead of day-to-day execution. You've done it all from managing schedules to
 & calendar management. You have a meticulous eye for detail where Prioritization and Organization are your love language



-- 1+ years of experience in Sales Funnels and Shopify

You're a professional who is passionate about helping changemakers simplify their lives by setting up systems that will allow them to operate their businesses with more ease and less overwhelm. You have experience with sales funnel and CRM software



- 1+ years of experience advertising on platforms like Instagram,
, Tik Tok, within a Marketing team consisting of Paid Acquisition, Organic Marketing, Customer Retention, & Product Marketing

You're an emerging leader who has the potential to head a team in the future that will report directly to you. Having leadership experience is a MAJOR plus



- Creating SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures)

You’ll ensure each business function has detailed documentation for repeatable and scalable growth if it isn't already place. If you see gaps, you take the initiative to fill them and produce results without anyone knowing there was an issue (yea, all that and a bag of chips :-)



- Experience working at a digital/online product/platform: You’re familiar with online courses, digital products & platforms and popular tools in the business space ranging from landing page builders and
 service providers to CRMs, and course hosting platforms aren’t foreign to you (We teach tools like Shopify, Convertkit, Kajabi, Teachable, Learnworlds, Calendly, etc)



ABOUT YOU:

- “You down with SOP? Yeah you know me!”—You’re an advocate for SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) to make our systems repeatable & scalable.

- Your love language is processes & predictable, meteoric growth. We never question company progress towards the quarterly and yearly goals because you keep real-time metrics for all projects.

- You’re aware of new software and can look at current systems and identify how to automate tasks a company has been doing manually for months.

- You’re addicted to digital processes & automation in the world of social media because you love building connections in the digital space and you’ve seen how powerful it can be in business growth

- You’re driven by metrics & tracking. You know that you can’t improve something unless you measure it, so you develop ways to measure performance so your company is always predictably improving.

- Timeliness and deadlines are your jam. When we have a team call at 10:00am, you show up at 9:55am. When the deadline is Tuesday at 5:30pm, you have it done Monday.

- You overcommunicate clearly and confidently. If you agree/disagree with something, you communicate that without hesitation or overthinking. You’re no stranger to asking why we do things a certain way to ensure we’re intentional with our resources.

- You’re a leader and team player. Ego? What ego? If something needs to be done, you dive in to make sure all critical tasks are accounted and cared for.



If you’re nodding your head “Yes” to the above, proceed below to apply.



PERKS:

I'm committed to setting our staff up for success with access to trainings that will certify your skills in:

- Task & Calendar Management

- Launch/Sales Strategy Planning

- Sales Funnel Tech Setup (For E-Commerce or Service Based Businesses)

- Social Media Management

- Digital Media Marketing (Including
 and SMS Marketing)

- Lead Generation



After one week of training and assessment, you're officially certified under our internal training program, which means hitting the ground running with your new skills. Perks include:

- Part time work hours

- Work from anywhere in the world (as long as your internet signal is strong and computer is fast)

- Starting Salary at $400-$500 USD a month ($4800 - $6000 USD annual)

- Internal certification program to enhance your professional skills in your career (I have helped clients amass at least $10M from the same digital growth marketing strategies I will require you to learn)



Interested? Please reply to this post with the secret keyword "APPLES" so I know you can pay attention to detail - from there, I'll let you know next steps if you qualify.

title: Customer Service Coordinator (Front Office)
description:
Purpose 



The Customer Service Coordinator is responsible for ensuring the efficient execution of daily customer service, scheduling, dispatch support, and administrative operations. Working in coordination with the company's AI-powered digital booking assistant and utilizing our Service Titan Field Service Management platform, this position provides human oversight and coordination to ensure that customer requests are handled accurately, appointments are properly scheduled, technicians are supported, and service commitments are fulfilled.



Experience & Skill Requirements )

Customer Service, Dispatching & Scheduling 

Service Titan – Certified User

Communication and Teamwork

Trade Experience



Priorities



The digital assistant and Web Simple Scheduler (AI technology) will answer routine incoming calls, book standard service appointments, collect customer and equipment information, create new customer records, reschedule/rebook on request and take messages or transfer all other customer items.

The Customer Service Coordinator serves as the critical human connection between customers, the AI booking system, field technicians, and company management, proactively identifying and resolving issues that technology cannot independently address.

1. No customer gets lost. Every call the AI cannot successfully resolve has a human follow-up.

2. No technician loses productive time. The front office keeps the dispatch board accurate and handles schedule disruptions and supports technicians in job execution, equipment/material availability, estimating and billing.

3. No booking errors reach the field. AI appointments are validated before they create wasted trips.

4. No unfinished job is forgotten. Return visits, parts needs, and customer commitments have clear ownership.

5. No revenue opportunity is overlooked. Unbooked leads, sold estimates, and cancellations are actively managed.

 

Daily Responsibilities (Monday through Friday 8:00AM to 5:00PM)

1. AI Booking Quality Control

a. Review every AI-booked job for correct customer name, address, phone number, and contact information. Verify the job type, business unit, service description, and appropriate appointment duration.

b. Validate/check all new customers for proper classifications, contact info, tags, business units and that no duplicate customers, locations, or jobs were created.

c. Review AI calls that failed to book, ended unexpectedly, or requested a human.

d. Correct misclassified calls, incorrect appointments, and incomplete job descriptions.

e. Verify materials and equipment are available to be used when repair/install job has been booked from an estimate

f. Add helpers to appropriate jobs requiring two or more people

g. Copy approved estimate details of work into jobs that have been booked for repair or installation (as needed) and mark them as sold



2. Dispatch and Scheduling

a. Review dispatch board before technicians begin work and confirm each technician has an appropriate workload, travel time, and assigned service area.

b. Resolve double bookings, schedule conflicts, and jobs booked outside available capacity.

c. Monitor technician progress and adjust schedules for overruns, cancellations, and emergencies.

d. Contact customers when technicians are delayed or appointment windows change.

e. Fill newly opened schedule slots from unscheduled calls and waiting customers.

f. Coordinate return visits, part-related appointments, and jobs requiring special skills.



3. Customer Communication and Recovery

a. Respond promptly to customers requesting a live person.

b. Complete all job bookings, new customer creation, schedule change requests, informational requests, estimate approvals and billing issues

c. Adress information requestions, dissatisfied customers, and escalated service issues.

d. Contact customers whose requests could not be completed by the AI and Follow up on abandoned calls, missed calls, and failed AI bookings.

e. Confirm special instructions, access issues, pets, gate codes, and decision-maker availability.

f. Manage appointment cancellations and rescheduling requests.

g. Resolve scheduling questions received by
, text, or online forms.



4. Technician and Field Support

a. Respond to technicians needing customer information, directions, or scheduling assistance.

b. Coordinate customer approval or contact when a technician cannot reach the homeowner.

c. Assist with jobs requiring another technician, additional time, or specialized equipment.

d. Coordinate urgent parts needs with Operations Manager

e. Confirm technicians communicate job completion, delays, and follow-up requirements.

f. Ensure incomplete jobs have an assigned next action and responsible owner.



5. Service Titan Data and Job Management

a. Review unassigned, unscheduled, and incorrectly categorized jobs.

b. Confirm jobs are linked to the correct customer, location, and equipment history.

c. Check for missing job notes, inaccurate tags, and incomplete booking details.

d. Review open, on-hold, in progress jobs requiring customer contact or additional scheduling.

e. Identify and resolve jobs completed in the field but still open administratively.



6. Revenue Protection and Follow-Up

a. Review and take action on unsold estimates requiring follow-up and/or mark them sold/approved/Dismissed

b. Take action to sell maintenance memberships and book maintenance visits

c. Contact customers who requested quotes but never scheduled an appointment.

d. Coordinate sold estimates that have not yet been converted into scheduled jobs.

e. Escalate service recovery issues that could lead to lost customers or negative reviews.

 

Recommended daily work schedule

Time Front office priorities

8:00–8:30 AM Review overnight AI bookings, urgent messages, cancellations, and dispatch board

8:30–9:00 AM Correct scheduling problems, contact customers, and prepare technicians

9:00–11:00 AM Monitor AI exceptions, technician progress, and same-day capacity

11:00 AM–1:00 PM Handle customer escalations, job changes, and unscheduled work

1:00–3:00 PM Follow up on estimates, return visits, and unresolved customer requests

3:00–4:00 PM Prepare tomorrow's schedule, verify assignments, and fill open slots

4:00–4:30 PM Review unresolved jobs, failed AI calls, and handoff items

AI exceptions, customer escalations, and dispatch problems should be handled continuously, not held until their assigned time block.

title: Video Editor for Short-Form Ads and VSLs (Freelance)
description:
Type: Freelance, paid per project

Pay: Per finished video. Quote your price for one ad (30 to 90 seconds) and one VSL (5 to 7 minutes). Each price includes up to 2 rounds of changes.



About us

FirstClient Group gets pre-qualified home buyers on the phone with US real estate teams. We run Meta ads, and we need an editor who can turn raw talking-head footage into ads people watch to the end.



What you’ll edit



Talking-head ads, 30 to 90 seconds: jump cuts, burned-in captions, the hook as text on screen in the first second, B-roll and screen recordings, and numbers on screen as they’re said. Export in 9:16 and 4:5.

VSLs (video sales letters), 5 to 7 minutes: jump cuts, captions, numbers on screen, chapter markers, and a 5 to 10 second clip for the video thumbnail.

A short re-enacted phone call, cut with captions.

First batch: 2 VSLs and 10 to 20 ads. After that, about 15 new ads a month.



How we edit



Each ad is its own video. Never move a hook from one ad onto another.

Clean and simple: jump cuts and captions, no heavy effects.

Blur names, phone numbers and addresses in screen recordings.

Send the project file with every edit. All footage and files belong to us.



You must have



At least 3 short-form talking-head edits and 1 longer video in your portfolio

CapCut, Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve

Strong written English. Captions must match what’s said, word for word.

Turnaround of 48 hours for an ad and 4 days for a VSL

Time for a check-in during Philippine mornings (Toronto evenings)



Nice to have



You can draft ad scripts and hooks from a framework we give you (quote this separately)

Experience editing real estate, coaching or agency ads



How to apply



Start your application with the words “Speed to lead” so we know you read this.

Send links to 3 short-form edits and 1 long video you edited.

Tell us your software, your weekly availability, and your price per ad and per VSL.

In one sentence: what makes the first 3 seconds of an ad work?

title: Ecommerce Video Editor for Meta ads
description:
# Video Editor for eCommerce Meta Ads



We are a fast-growing eCommerce company doing **6 figures a month**, selling health and beauty products to a 45+ audience through direct-response funnels.



We are currently active in **4 markets across Europe** and are expanding into new markets over time.



Our traffic comes from Meta ads, so **high-performing video creatives are one of the most important parts of our business.**



We are looking for a **skilled video editor** who can help us create, edit, adapt and test different types of video ads.



This includes everything from **UGC-style ads, B-roll videos with voiceovers, AI-generated video ads, product demonstrations and variations of existing winning ads.**



**Before applying, please read the 4R model for this role here:**



4R model: [
](
)



This document explains the role, responsibilities, requirements and expected results in more detail.



## What you will be doing



Your main responsibility will be **creating and editing video ads for
 and Instagram.**



You will:



- Edit short-form direct-response video ads for Meta campaigns

- Create B-roll-based video ads using voiceovers, stock footage, product visuals and other relevant clips

- Combine voiceovers, captions, B-roll, music and sound effects into engaging video ads

- Edit AI-generated video footage and combine it with real footage when needed

- Translate or adapt existing video ads for different countries and languages

- Create new variations of existing winning video ads

- Adapt ads for different products, marketing angles and target audiences

- Add engaging hooks, captions, transitions, product shots and call-to-action sections

- Follow scripts, storyboards, creative briefs and examples provided by our team

- Improve video pacing, storytelling and visual flow to keep viewers engaged

- Make changes and improvements based on feedback

- Export finished videos in the correct formats for Meta campaigns



**The type of editing will vary depending on the task.**



Some videos will be simple B-roll edits with a voiceover and captions. Others may involve combining multiple types of footage, editing UGC content or working with AI-generated visuals.



We are looking for someone who is comfortable working with different video styles rather than specialising in just one.



## How we work



We are an eCommerce business using:



- Funnel-based selling

- Direct-response marketing

- Weekly creative testing for all of our products across multiple markets

- Fast product launches

- Structured workflows and clear instructions



In some cases, your task will be straightforward. For example, you may only need to translate an existing winning video ad into another language, replace the voiceover, update the captions and adjust a few visuals.



In other cases, you will receive a detailed creative brief that explains:



- The product and target audience

- The marketing angle and main message

- The hook and video structure

- The script

- The types of footage and visuals needed

- Examples of the editing style we want



Your job will be to turn these instructions into a **clean, engaging video ad that is ready to launch and test.**



At the beginning, our priority is finding someone who can follow our instructions, references and creative briefs very accurately.



Once you understand our style, audience and creative testing process, we are happy to give you more freedom to suggest your own improvements and creative ideas.



### Hourly work, productivity targets & deadlines



**We work on an hourly basis, but we also set clear time targets for how long different types of tasks should take.**



These targets help you understand how much time to allocate to each task, allowing you to **plan and organise your working day in the way that suits you best.**



We believe in giving you flexibility over how you structure your day, as long as you manage your workload efficiently and consistently deliver your work on time.



When a creative brief is provided, we expect you to plan your work accordingly and not leave everything until the day before the deadline.



**The goal of these time targets is to give you the freedom to manage your own schedule while ensuring that every creative is completed before its deadline, without compromising on quality.**



## Tools we provide



We provide access to the tools needed to create and edit our video ads.



For video editing, we can provide access to **
** (for adding accurate subtitles in foreign languages).



For AI-assisted video creation and visual production, we provide access to tools such as **Higgsfield, Claude, ChatGPT, Magnific and ElevenLabs.**



## What we are looking for



We are looking for someone who is **experienced in video editing, reliable, detail-oriented and has a good understanding of what makes an advertisement engaging.**



You should be:



- Experienced in editing short-form video content

- Experienced editing Meta video ads

- Skilled at combining B-roll footage, voiceovers, captions and sound effects

- Able to create videos that look natural, engaging and professional

- Good at selecting footage that matches the script and message

- Able to edit videos with strong hooks, engaging pacing and smooth visual flow

- Comfortable working with UGC-style and direct-response video formats

- Able to follow detailed instructions and references accurately

- Able to produce multiple variations of the same video concept

- Able to stay organised and manage multiple editing tasks

- Reliable, deadline-focused and responsive to feedback

- Willing to learn new tools and editing techniques when needed



**Important: This is not simply a role where you make videos look visually attractive.**



We create videos to sell products.



That means understanding how to capture attention in the first few seconds, keep people watching, match the visuals to the voiceover and deliver a clear message.



You should be open to learning about marketing and why videos work. We will provide the scripts, angles, examples and instructions.



## What we offer



- **Part-time work to start**

- **Opportunity to grow into a full-time position** based on performance and business needs

- **$6 per hour starting rate (over time there is the possibility to higher pay when delivering high performing ads)**

- Long-term collaboration

- Consistent video editing work

- Clear creative briefs, examples and structured workflows

- Access to advanced creative and AI tools

- Ongoing product launches and opportunities to work on different products

- Opportunities to develop your editing skills and creative understanding

- A fast-moving, performance-driven team



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the company, not just complete a few one-off projects.



As we expand into more markets and increase our creative testing volume, there will be opportunities to take on more hours and responsibilities.



## How to apply



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your experience with video editing

3. **Examples of video ads you have personally edited** (portfolio or links)

4. Your experience with B-roll, voiceovers, UGC and other video formats

5. The video editing software you normally use

6. Any experience you have with eCommerce or Meta ads

7. Your availability and how many hours per week you can work



**Please make sure to include examples of your previous video editing work. Applications without video examples will not be considered.**



Looking forward to hearing from you!

title: GTM Engineer
description:
Ultra Labs is hiring a GTM Engineer to build and run the technical backbone of our revenue engine. You will own the automation, integrations and AI-powered systems behind our go-to-market motion, from first touch through closed-won.

This is a builder role. You will connect our CRM, enrichment platforms, AI orchestration layer and internal tools so every rep has the right data, the right intelligence and the right automation at every stage of the funnel.



Ultra Labs is a U.S.–based Business Incubator/Accelerator focused on software and tech-driven businesses.



What you'll do

• AI and MCP architecture. Design, build and maintain Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that connect LLMs to our CRM, project management, communication and data platforms. Own the LLM integration layer: prompt engineering, agent orchestration and tool-use patterns.

• Agentic workflows. Build AI agents that automate prospect research, account planning, competitive intelligence, deal analysis and personalized outreach. Own an agent-per-rep framework that multiplies each rep's capacity.

• CRM automation and intelligence. Design multi-step workflows for lead scoring, lifecycle stages, lead routing, deal stage automation and custom objects. Build CRM card extensions and AI-powered UI that surface insights inside the rep's workflow.

• Integration architecture. Own the connections across the revenue stack: CRM, enrichment, project management, contracts, billing, compensation and communication tools. Build and maintain APIs, webhook handlers and middleware that keep systems in sync.

• Enrichment pipelines. Build waterfall enrichment, ICP scoring models, credit governance and per-rep enrichment limits. Own the data flow from enrichment providers into the CRM for both high-touch and automated segments.

• Outbound infrastructure. Own SDR sequence architecture: deliverability, domain and sender rotation, A/B testing and performance monitoring. Make sure outbound scales with headcount without manual bottlenecks.

• Data quality and governance. Maintain deduplication rules, field mapping standards and data hygiene across [10,000+] accounts. Monitor provider reliability and manage failover between enrichment sources.

• Ship weekly, document everything. Release on a weekly sprint cadence with leadership demos before production. Every change ships with release notes, updated guidance and documentation.



What you'll need

• 3+ years in GTM Engineering, Revenue Systems, Marketing Ops Engineering or Sales Ops Engineering at a B2B SaaS company.

• Deep CRM expertise (HubSpot preferred; Salesforce welcome): workflows, custom objects, calculated properties, lead scoring, lifecycle management and API integrations.

• Hands-on experience with enrichment platforms (Clay preferred): waterfall logic, ICP list building, credit management and pipeline design.

• Production experience with LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI or similar): prompt engineering, tool use and function calling, structured outputs and agentic workflow design.

• Working knowledge of MCP or similar tool-use frameworks, and the ability to build, deploy and maintain MCP servers.

• Comfort with middleware (n8n, Make, Zapier) and with writing JavaScript or Python to bridge systems directly through APIs.

• Experience owning the tooling stack for an outbound SDR team of 3 to 10+ reps.

• A track record of building GTM infrastructure from scratch at a scaling company, not only maintaining existing systems.

• A documentation-first mindset: release notes, runbooks and walkthrough recordings for everything you ship.



Nice to have

• Experience with sales engagement tools (Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo or Instantly) and
 deliverability tooling.

• Familiarity with data warehouses and reverse ETL (Snowflake, BigQuery, Hightouch or Census).

• Experience building internal tools or lightweight front ends for reps.

title: Bookkeeping Auditor
description:
About the Opportunity



We are looking for a detail-oriented, analytical, and highly organized Bookkeeping Auditor to help ensure the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of our financial records.

In this role, you’ll review bookkeeping entries, financial transactions, invoices, receipts, expense records, and reconciliations to identify errors, inconsistencies, missing documentation, and potential issues. You’ll help maintain accurate financial records by verifying that transactions are properly recorded, supporting documents are complete, and discrepancies are identified and addressed.



This position is ideal for someone with a sharp eye for detail, a strong understanding of bookkeeping principles, and the ability to investigate financial discrepancies rather than simply flagging them. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership of their work and understands the importance of accuracy, consistency, and confidentiality.



Key Responsibilities



Financial Record Review & Auditing

- Review bookkeeping entries, financial statements, invoices, receipts, expense reports, and supporting documentation for accuracy and completeness.

- Verify that financial transactions are recorded in the correct accounts and reporting periods.

- Examine income, expenses, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and other financial records for inconsistencies.

- Check that transactions are supported by appropriate documentation and follow established bookkeeping procedures.

- Identify duplicate entries, missing transactions, incorrect classifications, and mathematical errors.

- Review adjustments and corrections to ensure they are properly documented and accurately reflected in the books.



Discrepancy Identification & Investigation

- Identify unusual transactions, unexplained balances, missing receipts, inconsistent amounts, and other financial irregularities.

- Investigate discrepancies by tracing transactions back to bank records, invoices, receipts, payment confirmations, and other source documents.

- Determine the likely cause of errors and document findings clearly.

- Coordinate with bookkeeping staff or relevant team members to clarify questionable entries and obtain missing documentation.

- Recommend corrective actions and follow up to ensure identified issues are resolved.

- Escalate significant, recurring, or unresolved discrepancies to the appropriate supervisor.



Quality Control & Process Improvement

- Conduct routine reviews of bookkeeping records to maintain consistent quality and accuracy.

- Develop and maintain checklists or review procedures to ensure financial records meet established standards.

- Monitor recurring errors and identify opportunities to strengthen bookkeeping workflows.

- Recommend improvements to documentation practices, transaction categorization, and internal financial controls.

- Help establish reliable review processes that reduce errors and improve accountability.

- Verify that previously identified issues have been corrected and do not continue to recur.



Reporting & Documentation

- Prepare clear reports summarizing audit findings, identified discrepancies, corrections needed, and unresolved issues.

- Maintain organized records of completed reviews, supporting documents, and corrective actions.

- Track outstanding audit findings and follow up with responsible team members.

- Provide management with accurate information regarding financial record quality and recurring bookkeeping issues.

- Ensure audit trails are maintained so transactions and adjustments can be traced and reviewed when necessary.



Confidentiality & Professional Standards

- Handle financial records, banking information, and sensitive business data with strict confidentiality.

- Follow established financial procedures, documentation requirements, and access controls.

- Maintain objectivity and accuracy when reviewing financial information.

- Ensure findings are supported by verifiable records and documented evidence.

- Exercise sound judgment when identifying issues that require further investigation or escalation.



What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is meticulous, analytical, trustworthy, and committed to maintaining accurate financial records.

Ideal candidates will have:

- Previous experience in bookkeeping, accounting, financial auditing, accounts payable, accounts receivable, or financial quality control.

- A solid understanding of bookkeeping principles, debits and credits, and financial transaction recording.

- Experience reviewing invoices, receipts, bank statements, expense records, and financial reports.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly when investigating discrepancies.

- Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to identify errors that others may overlook.

- Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple reviews and deadlines.

- Proficiency with bookkeeping or accounting software such as QuickBooks, Xero, or similar platforms.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including the ability to review, compare, and analyze financial data.

- Clear written communication skills and the ability to document findings accurately.

- The ability to work independently, follow established procedures, and take ownership of assigned tasks.

- A strong commitment to confidentiality, accuracy, and accountability.

- An accounting degree, bookkeeping certification, or relevant professional training is a plus.



What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means helping ensure that the company’s financial records are accurate, complete, properly documented, and reliable.

You’ll help ensure:

- Bookkeeping entries and financial transactions are recorded accurately.

- Errors, duplicate entries, and missing documentation are identified promptly.

- Financial discrepancies are investigated and supported by clear findings.

- Corrections are documented and completed appropriately.

- Audit findings are tracked through resolution.

- Recurring bookkeeping errors are reduced over time.

- Financial records are organized, traceable, and ready for management review.

- Bookkeeping processes become more consistent, efficient, and dependable.



How to Apply

If you enjoy analyzing financial records, identifying discrepancies, solving problems, and maintaining high standards of accuracy, we’d love to hear from you.



Please submit your resume highlighting your experience in bookkeeping, accounting, auditing, or financial quality control. Be sure to include the accounting software and financial tools you have used, along with examples of your experience reviewing records, identifying errors, and helping maintain accurate financial information.

title: Operations Lead

About the Opportunity



We are looking for a proactive, organized, and solutions-driven Operations Lead to oversee daily operations, strengthen internal workflows, and ensure our team operates efficiently, consistently, and in alignment with company objectives.

In this role, you’ll take ownership of operational processes, coordinate team activities, identify inefficiencies, and implement practical improvements that support productivity, accountability, and business growth. You’ll work closely with leadership and different departments to ensure responsibilities are clearly defined, deadlines are met, and operational challenges are addressed before they become larger issues.



This position is ideal for someone who enjoys solving problems, improving systems, managing priorities, and helping teams perform at their best. We’re looking for a hands-on leader who can turn operational challenges into effective solutions and build processes that support long-term success.



Key Responsibilities



Operations Management & Oversight

- Oversee daily business operations to ensure tasks, projects, and workflows are completed accurately and on schedule.

- Coordinate activities across departments to maintain alignment with company priorities and operational goals.

- Monitor task completion, deadlines, resource allocation, and overall team productivity.

- Ensure operational activities follow established company policies, procedures, and performance standards.

- Encourage collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement across the organization.

- Develop, document, and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) to promote consistency and efficiency.

- Evaluate operational challenges and implement practical, measurable solutions.

- Establish systems for tracking tasks, monitoring progress, and ensuring timely follow-through.

- Identify repetitive manual tasks that could benefit from automation or improved technology.

- Coordinate process changes and ensure team members understand and follow updated procedures.

- Measure the effectiveness of improvements and make adjustments when needed.



Project Coordination & Execution

- Coordinate operational projects, initiatives, and cross-functional assignments from planning through completion.

- Establish project timelines, assign responsibilities, and monitor milestones.

- Follow up with team members to ensure deliverables are completed on time and meet expectations.

- Identify risks, dependencies, and potential delays and implement solutions to keep projects moving.

- Maintain organized project documentation, task trackers, and progress reports.

- Ensure projects remain aligned with company objectives, available resources, and established priorities.

Performance Monitoring & Strategic Reporting

- Review operational data to identify trends, recurring challenges, and opportunities for improvement.

- Prepare regular reports highlighting team performance, project status, workflow issues, and progress toward operational goals.

- Translate performance metrics into actionable recommendations for management.

- Track the implementation and results of operational improvement initiatives.

- Escalate significant risks, resource constraints, and unresolved issues to leadership.



Compliance, Documentation & Confidentiality

- Ensure operational processes follow established company policies, internal controls, and applicable compliance requirements.

- Maintain accurate documentation of procedures, decisions, workflows, and operational changes.

- Promote responsible handling of confidential business, employee, and client information.

- Ensure team members understand and follow relevant data protection and information security procedures.

- Identify process gaps that may create operational, compliance, or information security risks and coordinate appropriate corrective action.



What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is dependable, analytical, resourceful, and confident managing people, processes, and competing priorities. Ideal candidates will have:

- Previous experience in operations management, team leadership, project coordination, process improvement, or business administration.

- Experience overseeing workflows, coordinating team responsibilities, and monitoring operational performance.

- Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to identify the root causes of operational challenges.

- Experience developing SOPs, improving workflows, and implementing more efficient processes.

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to coordinate across departments and provide constructive feedback.

- Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as Asana, ClickUp, Trello, 
, or similar platforms.

- Proficiency in Google Workspace, including Google Sheets, Docs, and related productivity tools.

- The ability to monitor KPIs, analyze performance data, and prepare clear operational reports.

- Strong leadership, decision-making, and follow-through skills.

- The ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining clear communication with management and  team members.

- A high level of professionalism, accountability, confidentiality, and attention to detail.

- Experience with workflow automation, CRM systems, or operational technology is a plus.

- A degree or relevant certification in business administration, operations management, or project management is a plus.



What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means ensuring that business operations are organized, efficient, accountable, and aligned with company goals.You’ll help ensure:

- Daily operations run smoothly, with clear responsibilities and priorities.

- Teams complete assigned tasks accurately and within established deadlines.

- Operational bottlenecks and recurring issues are identified and addressed promptly.

- Standardized procedures improve consistency and reduce unnecessary work.

- Team performance is measured, monitored, and improved over time.

- Projects move forward with clear ownership, timelines, and deliverables.

- Systems and tools support better communication, visibility, and productivity.

- Management receives timely, actionable insights into operational performance.

- Confidential information is handled appropriately and internal procedures are followed.

- Continuous improvement becomes part of the team’s day-to-day operations.



What We Offer

How to Apply

• Write direct-response scripts and d
 the complete video structure

, Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest
