description:
Amazing Listing Photos | Full-Time | Remote



About Us



Amazing Listing Photos (ALP) is a growing real estate media company serving real estate professionals across multiple U.S. markets. We produce professional photography, property videos, virtual tours, and marketing content that helps agents showcase their listings and stand out from the competition.



We’re looking for an experienced, highly creative Real Estate Video Editor to take ownership of our daily video editing operations while helping us continually improve and expand our video offerings.



This is not a position for someone who simply follows instructions, edits footage, and moves on to the next assignment.



We want someone who is passionate about real estate video, pays attention to what’s happening in the industry, and consistently brings fresh ideas to the table.



What You’ll Do



Daily Video Production



* Take ownership of editing our daily real estate video orders, ensuring every project is completed accurately, consistently, and on time.

* Edit property walkthrough videos, cinematic property tours, vertical social media videos, agent-focused content, and other marketing videos.

* Work with footage from professional cameras, smartphones, gimbals, and drones.

* Perform professional color correction, color grading, stabilization, audio mixing, and other post-production enhancements.

* Select appropriate music, pacing, transitions, and effects to complement each property.

* Create both branded and unbranded versions of videos as required.

* Optimize videos for various formats, including websites, MLS platforms, YouTube, Instagram,
, and TikTok.

* Maintain an organized editing workflow that supports our next-day delivery commitments.

* Perform quality-control reviews to ensure deliverables meet our standards before delivery.



Creative Research & Innovation



A significant part of this position involves helping us stay ahead of the competition.



* Regularly research Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and other platforms to discover emerging trends in real estate videography and editing.

* Follow leading real estate media companies, luxury property filmmakers, and creative content producers for inspiration.

* Proactively identify new editing techniques, transitions, storytelling approaches, and video formats worth exploring.

* Bring new ideas to management rather than waiting to be asked.

* Experiment with creative concepts and produce sample edits demonstrating how they could improve our offerings.

* Recommend improvements to our current video packages, including opportunities to introduce new deliverables.

* Explore emerging AI-powered editing tools and automation opportunities that can improve our efficiency without sacrificing quality.

* Help establish and refine editing styles, templates, and standards as the company grows.



Collaboration & Continuous Improvement



* Work closely with our photographers, operations team, and management to maintain consistency across markets.

* Provide constructive feedback to photographers about footage quality, camera movements, composition, and shooting techniques.

* Identify recurring production challenges and recommend solutions.

* Develop efficient editing workflows, presets, and templates to maintain quality as volume increases.

* Help establish distinct editing styles for our standard real estate videos and premium luxury property productions.

* Stay informed about advances in video editing software, artificial intelligence, and real estate marketing.



What We’re Looking For



Required Qualifications



* At least 3 years of professional video editing experience, with substantial experience editing real estate videos.

* A strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality residential property videos, including walkthroughs and cinematic edits.

* Advanced proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or comparable professional editing software.

* Strong understanding of color grading, exposure, white balance, audio editing, pacing, and visual storytelling.

* Experience producing vertical short-form content for social media.

* Ability to manage multiple daily projects while consistently meeting strict deadlines.

* Excellent attention to detail and the ability to maintain consistent quality without constant supervision.

* Strong communication skills and the ability to receive and implement feedback.

* A proactive, self-directed mindset and genuine enthusiasm for improving your work.



Highly Preferred



* Experience editing luxury real estate films or other premium architectural content.

* Experience with drone footage and advanced cinematic editing techniques.

* Familiarity with motion graphics, animated titles, and property feature callouts.

* Experience using After Effects and AI-assisted editing tools.

* An understanding of real estate marketing and what makes property videos effective for agents.

* Experience developing reusable editing templates and streamlining production workflows.



What Success Looks Like



We’re looking for someone who takes ownership of both the daily production workload and the long-term improvement of our video offerings.



Success in this position means:



* Reliable delivery: Videos are consistently completed on schedule without management needing to follow up.

* Excellent quality: Editing is polished, consistent, and rarely requires revisions or corrections.

* Creative initiative: You regularly introduce useful ideas, techniques, or concepts that we haven’t considered.

* Continuous improvement: Our videos become noticeably better over time, not simply faster to produce.

* Efficiency: You develop smarter workflows that allow us to handle increasing video volume while maintaining quality.

* Collaboration: You help our photographers capture better footage by providing useful and actionable feedback.



Who Will Thrive in This Role?



You’ll be a great fit if you’re the type of editor who sees an impressive real estate video on Instagram and immediately starts thinking about how to recreate or improve the technique.



You’re someone who notices the small details that separate an average property video from an exceptional one.



You can work independently, manage deadlines, and consistently produce excellent results. But you’re also excited to experiment, learn new techniques, and help shape the creative direction of a growing media company.



We’re not looking for someone who is content doing things the same way every day. We’re looking for someone who wants to help set a higher standard.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your portfolio: Share at least three real estate videos you’ve personally edited. Include both standard walkthroughs and cinematic or social media edits, if available.

2. Your experience: Briefly describe your experience editing real estate videos, the software you use, and your typical editing turnaround time.

3. Your creative perspective: Share one real estate video or editing trend you’ve recently noticed and explain how you think we could incorporate it into our services.

4. Your availability: Include your preferred working hours and availability to meet deadlines based on U.S. Eastern Time.



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a paid editing assessment using footage supplied by our team.



We’re looking for a long-term team member who wants to help us build something exceptional.

title: Short-Let Property Maintenance Manager
description:
Company Description:

We operate a rapidly growing serviced accommodation management business that markets our properties on online travel agent (OTA) websites such as Airbnb and 
. Catering to both leisure and contractor worker guests, we provide quality short-stay accommodation across the UK. With a strong focus on expansion, we are actively working to increase the number of assets under management and strengthen our presence in the market. We currently manage 40 short-let properties and are looking to grow to over 100 over the next 6 months. We are looking for a Short-Let Property Maintenance Manager to take full ownership of maintenance and repairs across our Airbnb and serviced accommodation portfolio.



Position Overview:

We are seeking an experienced, organised and proactive Short-Let Property Maintenance Manager to own every maintenance issue across our UK Airbnb and serviced accommodation portfolio, from the moment a guest or cleaner reports it to the moment it is fixed, recovered and closed.



Please note: this is a short-term rental role, not a long-term lettings role. Our properties turn over guests every few days, often with same-day check-out and check-in. Repairs must be fixed around live bookings, guests in residence and cleaning turnarounds - often within hours, not days. Every unresolved issue risks a cancellation, a refund or a poor review that directly affects our listings' rankings and income.



We want someone who takes ownership, moves fast, follows up relentlessly, keeps guests and property owners informed without being chased, and builds systems that will hold as we scale from 40 to 100+ properties. This role has strong promotion potential as the portfolio grows.



Key Responsibilities:



Guest-Reported Issues (In-Stay):

- Acknowledge every maintenance issue reported by guests during their stay promptly, empathetically and professionally - via Airbnb, 
 and direct booking messaging.

- Triage each issue by urgency and impact on the guest's stay (emergency / affects stay now / can wait until check-out) and act accordingly.

- Troubleshoot remotely with guests where possible (e.g. Wi-Fi resets, boiler pressure, tripped fuses, smart lock or key safe issues, appliance settings) before booking a contractor.

- Gather clear photos and videos from guests to diagnose the problem accurately.

- Arrange contractor access around the guest's stay, notify guests of arrival times and expected completion, and confirm that the guest is happy for entry.

- Confirm with guests once works are completed and check the issue is fully resolved before they check out or leave a review.

- Work alongside our Customer Success team so each guest receives one clear, consistent line of communication.



Turnaround & Booking Protection:

- Act on maintenance issues flagged by cleaners in their post-clean photo reports, prioritising anything that must be fixed before the next guest arrives.

- Coordinate contractors around check-out and check-in times and cleaning schedules so properties are guest-ready on time.

- D
, with management, when a property cannot safely be let, block calendars in our channel manager (Hostaway) and inform the guest relations team so upcoming guests can be contacted.

- Keep a running view of which properties have open issues against upcoming arrivals.



Contractor Coordination:

- Call and message our local contractors (plumbers, electricians, gas engineers, handymen, locksmiths, appliance repair) to book same-day, next-day and planned jobs.

- Obtain quotes, agree attendance times and chase until the job is complete.

- Source and vet new contractors in new areas as we onboard properties, including checking insurance and qualifications (e.g. Gas Safe, NICEIC), and their ability to respond quickly.

- Build and maintain our contractor directory by area in ClickUp.

- Collect invoices, before/after photos and job reports for every completed job.



Property Owner Communication:

- Inform property owners of required repairs, quotes and costs in a clear, professional manner.

- Obtain owner approval for works above the defined approval limits before instructing contractors.

- Keep owners updated through to completion and pass invoices to our Finance team for reconciliation.



Guest Damage & Cost Recovery:

- Identify guest-caused damage using cleaner photo reports, inventory checks and check-in/check-out evidence.

- Prepare damage evidence packs (photos, invoices, timelines) and recover costs via SuiteOp security deposits or OTA damage claim processes (Airbnb Resolution Centre, 
) within the platforms' strict deadlines.

- Communicate damage charges to guests professionally and factually, following company procedure and approval limits.



Planned Maintenance & Short-Let Compliance:

- Schedule preventative maintenance suited to high-turnover properties (e.g. boiler servicing, appliance checks, grouting and sealant, furniture and linen wear, smoke/CO alarm and fire safety equipment testing).

- Plan larger works into gaps in the booking calendar to avoid cancelling guests.

- Track renewal dates for property compliance certificates required for short-term letting (e.g. Gas Safety, EICR, fire safety checks) and book renewals before they expire.

- Liaise with block management companies on communal and building-level issues affecting guest access or safety.



Systems & Reporting:

- Log, track and update every job in ClickUp from report to close.

- Spot recurring issues and recommend permanent fixes rather than repeat call-outs.

- Report weekly on open jobs, response times, costs, blocked nights and recovered damages.

- Maintain strong team communication via ClickUp, Slack and WhatsApp.



Key Qualifications:

- Minimum 2 years' experience coordinating maintenance for short-term rental, Airbnb or serviced accommodation properties (required). Experience in long-term residential lettings only will not be sufficient for this role.

- Experience supporting a multi-property short-let portfolio, ideally in the UK - you must tell us which company or companies.

- Understanding of how maintenance issues affect guest experience, reviews, cancellations and listing performance on Airbnb and 
.

- Experience with OTA damage claims (Airbnb Resolution Centre, 
) is highly desirable.

- Confidence making phone calls to UK contractors, guests and property owners, including chasing, negotiating and handling difficult conversations.

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English.

- Good working knowledge of common household systems (boilers, plumbing, electrics, appliances, smart locks) - enough to troubleshoot remotely and spot a vague or inflated quote.

- Highly organised, with the ability to manage 10-20 open jobs at once against live booking deadlines without anything slipping.

- Calm under pressure - leaks, lockouts and no-heating calls with guests in residence will happen.

- Adaptability and willingness to learn new systems and processes (full training on our procedures provided).

Job Title: Prefab BIM Modeller

Company Description: We are a leading provider of specialized workforce solutions and technical support across structural engineering, prefabrication, and modular construction projects.

• Generate and edit structural steel items (main members, bracing, purlins, mesh grating panels, handrails, temporary works, equipment skids, connections, baseplates, and anchor details) within existing Revit shared models.

• Develop standard details for common and repeat designs.

• Extract quantities and create schedules from Revit models for prefabrication items (structural steel, grating, handrails, purlins).

• Run clash detection and conduct design reviews to highlight buildability issues for prefabrication items.

• Synchronize models regularly on live projects to meet weekly BIM coordination cycles.

• Maintain constant communication with the Design Manager Prefab, BIM Coordinators, and site teams during pre-assembly and installation.



Required Experience:

• Minimum 3 years’ experience in Revit modelling and drafting.

• Minimum 3 years’ experience in Structural Steel projects.

• Strong knowledge of mechanical building services / HVAC & plumbing and their fabrication requirements.

• Strong knowledge of Australian construction industry terminology and practices.

• Experience with Tekla Structures or Autodesk Inventor.



Required Education:

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

 Part-Time / Full-Time / Contract (Depending on Experience)

title: Commercial Editor
description:
We are a commercial video and photography company based in Charlotte, North Carolina.



This is a long post for a high paying per video basis. Please read it all.



We create high-end visual content for national brands, luxury apartment communities, real estate developers, corporate clients, and major events. Our work includes lifestyle campaigns, website films, architectural videos, brand stories, interviews, commercials, and social media content.



We already have a successful remote editing workflow and are now looking for an experienced freelance editor to work on our larger commercial video projects.



This is a project-based position, not a full-time position.



We are looking for someone we can begin with on individual projects and continue giving consistent work to when the quality, communication, and turnaround are strong.



-The Role



You will edit lifestyle videos, website films, brand campaigns, architectural property videos, interviews, and other commercial projects.



Most standard projects will be approximately 60 seconds to 2 minutes long, although certain projects may be longer or more complex.



You will generally receive organized footage, a creative brief, brand information, music direction, and examples of the intended style.



We need someone who can take professionally captured footage and turn it into a polished, cinematic commercial video that feels intentional from beginning to end.



The right person understands that a premium commercial edit is more than placing attractive clips over music.



Shot selection, pacing, storytelling, music editing, sound design, color, transitions, and small details all matter.



-Responsibilities



• Edit polished lifestyle, real estate, architectural, corporate, and commercial videos



• Review and organize professionally captured footage



• Select the strongest shots rather than simply using every clip provided



• Build a clear visual story with strong pacing and emotional progression



• Edit music intentionally to support the story and visual rhythm



• Add tasteful sound design that improves the video without becoming distracting



• Edit interviews and dialogue when required



• Perform professional color correction and color grading



• Match footage captured on multiple professional cinema cameras



• Create clean titles, logos, and simple motion graphics when needed



• Follow client brand standards and project-specific creative direction



• Manage revisions carefully and complete every requested change



• Deliver organized project files and final exports on schedule



• Communicate clearly regarding availability and turnaround time



-The Type of Work We Produce



Our videos often feature:



• Luxury apartment communities and real estate developments



• Professional lifestyle models



• Restaurants, coffee shops, neighborhoods, and local businesses



• Architecture, interiors, amenities, and exterior spaces



• Corporate interviews and recruiting content



• Branded campaigns and website videos



• Event films and commercial recaps



Our style is premium, cinematic, natural, and modern.



We are not looking for aggressive social media effects, excessive transitions, random speed ramps, or templates that make every project look the same.



The editing should support the footage rather than overpower it.



-Required Experience



• A strong portfolio of professional commercial or cinematic video work



• Advanced experience with Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve



• Strong understanding of pacing, visual storytelling, music, and sound design



• Professional color correction and grading ability



• Experience working with LOG footage and multiple camera formats



• Strong attention to detail



• Reliable internet and a computer capable of handling professional 4K and 6K footage through proxy workflows



• Ability to follow detailed feedback without repeatedly missing revisions



• Good written English and dependable communication



• Ability to meet agreed deadlines



-Preferred Experience



The following experience is valuable but not required:



• Luxury real estate or multifamily property videos



• Hospitality, travel, fashion, or lifestyle campaigns



• Commercial brand films



• Architectural video editing



• Corporate interviews



• Motion graphics using After Effects



• DaVinci Resolve color grading



• Experience collaborating with American production companies or agencies



-This Position Is Not a Fit If



• Most of your experience is limited to basic Reels, TikToks, podcasts, or talking-head videos



• You rely heavily on templates, presets, or automated editing



• You add transitions and effects simply because they look interesting



• You need every shot and creative decision selected for you



• You frequently miss small revision notes



• You apply without carefully reading the complete posting



We care more about your portfolio and creative judgment than your degree, certifications, or number of years working.



-Project Rates



This is a freelance, project-based position.



Most standard lifestyle and website videos will pay between $250 and $400 USD per completed project, depending on the length, complexity, footage volume, turnaround requirements, and level of creative involvement.



More complex projects involving interviews, longer runtimes, advanced sound design, motion graphics, or additional deliverables will be priced separately before work begins.



A standard project will generally include:



• One primary video approximately 60 seconds to 2 minutes long



• Professionally captured and organized footage



• Creative direction and reference examples



• Shot selection and full edit



• Music editing and sound design



• Color correction and grading



• Basic titles or logo placement



• Two reasonable rounds of revisions



Additional versions, major creative changes, extensive motion graphics, or work outside the original scope will be discussed and approved separately.



Editors who consistently produce strong work, communicate well, and meet deadlines will receive priority for future projects. We regularly produce commercial content and are looking to build a long-term relationship with the right person.



-Paid Editing Test



Final candidates may be invited to complete a paid editing test using footage supplied by RedefineU Media.



The paid test rate will be between $100 and $150 USD, depending on the requested deliverable.



The test will evaluate:



• Shot selection



• Storytelling



• Pacing



• Music editing



• Sound design



• Color



• Attention to detail



• Ability to follow creative direction



The test footage and completed edit may not be shared, posted, or used in a public portfolio without written permission.



-How to Apply



Please include all of the following:



1. A short introduction explaining your commercial editing experience



2. A link to your portfolio or reel



3. Links to the three projects that best represent the quality of work you would deliver for us



4. A brief explanation of what you personally completed on each project



5. Your primary editing software



6. Your computer specifications and internet speed



7. Your typical turnaround time for a 60 to 120-second commercial video



8. Your current availability



9. Your requested project rate



10. ***The phrase “Planned Like Architecture” In the subject of application *** This is to ensure you read this



Please do not send a general portfolio containing dozens of unrelated videos.



Show us your best commercial, lifestyle, hospitality, real estate, architectural, or brand work.



We are looking for someone who wants an ongoing freelance relationship and takes pride in producing excellent work.

title: Bookkeeping Reconciliation Specialist
description:
About the Opportunity



We are looking for a detail-oriented, organized, and analytical Bookkeeping Reconciliation Specialist to help maintain accurate financial records by reconciling bank accounts, payment records, bookkeeping entries, and other financial transactions.

In this role, you’ll compare financial records across different sources, verify that transactions match, investigate discrepancies, and ensure that outstanding differences are properly documented and resolved. You’ll play an important role in maintaining reliable financial information and helping the team identify missing transactions, duplicate entries, incorrect amounts, and other inconsistencies.



This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working with numbers, is comfortable investigating discrepancies, and takes pride in ensuring that every transaction is accounted for. We’re looking for someone who is methodical, dependable, and persistent when resolving financial issues.



Key Responsibilities



Bank & Account Reconciliation

- Reconcile bank statements against bookkeeping records to verify that balances and transactions agree.

- Compare deposits, withdrawals, transfers, fees, and other banking activity with recorded transactions.

- Reconcile business bank accounts, credit card accounts, payment processor balances, and other assigned financial accounts.

- Verify that transactions are recorded in the correct accounts and accounting periods.

- Identify outstanding checks, deposits in transit, unrecorded bank fees, duplicate entries, and other timing or recording differences.

- Ensure reconciliation schedules are completed accurately and within established deadlines.

- Maintain supporting documentation for completed reconciliations and account balances.



Transaction Matching & Verification

- Match receipts, invoices, payment confirmations, bank transactions, and bookkeeping entries.

- Verify that recorded payments correspond to the correct invoices, clients, vendors, or accounts.

- Review incoming payments, outgoing payments, refunds, transfers, and adjustments for accuracy.

- Identify missing, duplicated, misclassified, or incorrectly recorded transactions.

- Investigate transactions that cannot be matched immediately and determine what additional information is needed.

- Ensure financial transactions are properly categorized and supported by appropriate documentation.



Discrepancy Investigation & Resolution

- Investigate differences between bank statements, accounting software, payment records, and internal financial reports.

- Trace discrepancies to their source by reviewing transaction histories and supporting documents.

- Communicate with relevant team members to clarify unclear transactions or obtain missing records.

- Prepare proposed adjustments or corrections in accordance with established procedures and approval requirements.

- Track unresolved discrepancies and follow up until they are resolved or appropriately escalated.

- Maintain clear notes explaining the cause of discrepancies and the steps taken to address them.

- Identify recurring reconciliation problems and recommend ways to prevent them.



Financial Record Maintenance & Reporting

- Maintain organized and up-to-date reconciliation schedules, transaction logs, and supporting documentation.

- Prepare reconciliation summaries that highlight matched transactions, outstanding items, and unresolved differences.

- Assist with month-end and period-end closing activities by ensuring assigned accounts are reconciled.

- Keep accurate records of completed reconciliations, adjustments, and outstanding items.

- Help ensure financial records are complete and ready for review by management or the accounting team.

- Maintain a clear audit trail for transactions, corrections, and reconciliation decisions.



Process Improvement & Internal Coordination

- Follow established reconciliation procedures and internal financial controls.

- Identify opportunities to improve transaction matching, documentation, and reconciliation workflows.

- Help reduce recurring errors and delays through consistent follow-up and accurate recordkeeping.

- Coordinate with bookkeeping, accounting, operations, and administrative team members to resolve financial questions.

- Recommend improvements to spreadsheets, reporting templates, and reconciliation tracking systems.

- Support consistent and timely financial reporting by ensuring reconciliations are completed and documented properly.



Confidentiality & Professionalism

- Handle bank statements, payment information, financial records, and other sensitive data with discretion.

- Follow established confidentiality, security, and financial documentation procedures.

- Maintain accuracy and objectivity when reviewing transactions.

- Obtain appropriate authorization before making adjustments or changing financial records.

- Communicate unresolved issues promptly and maintain accountability for assigned reconciliations.



What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is accurate, persistent, analytical, and comfortable working with detailed financial information.

Ideal candidates will have:

- Previous experience in bookkeeping, bank reconciliation, accounting, accounts payable, accounts receivable, or financial administration.

- A solid understanding of bookkeeping fundamentals, debits and credits, and transaction recording.

- Hands-on experience reconciling bank statements, credit card accounts, payment records, or general ledger accounts.

- The ability to match transactions across multiple records and identify discrepancies.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to trace differences back to their source.

- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy when handling financial data.

- Proficiency with accounting software such as QuickBooks, Xero, or similar platforms.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for comparing transactions, tracking outstanding items, and preparing reconciliation reports.

- Good organizational skills and the ability to manage recurring deadlines.

- Strong written communication skills for documenting discrepancies and communicating with team members.

- The ability to work independently, maintain consistent productivity, and follow established procedures.

- A high level of integrity and commitment to financial accuracy and confidentiality.

- A bookkeeping or accounting certification, relevant coursework, or an accounting degree is a plus.



What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means ensuring that financial transactions are properly matched, account balances are supported, and discrepancies are resolved in a timely manner.

You’ll help ensure:

- Bank statements and bookkeeping records are reconciled accurately.

- Transactions are matched to the correct payments, invoices, and accounts.

- Missing, duplicate, and incorrectly recorded transactions are identified.

- Unexplained differences are investigated and tracked through resolution.

- Outstanding reconciliation items are documented and followed up on.

- Account balances are supported by reliable records and documentation.

- Month-end reconciliation tasks are completed accurately and on schedule.

- Financial records remain organized, consistent, and ready for review.



How to Apply

If you enjoy working with numbers, matching transactions, investigating discrepancies, and keeping financial records accurate and organized, we’d love to hear from you.



Please submit your resume highlighting your experience in bookkeeping, bank reconciliation, or accounting support. description:

Are you an experienced IT systems engineer or solutions consultant who thrives at the intersection of architecture, project execution, and strategic client advisory? If you enjoy translating complex business challenges into resilient cloud and infrastructure designs, driving end-to-end project cutovers, and serving as the trusted technical authority for business leaders, this role was built for you.



We bridge the gap between high-level consulting and real-world engineering. As our Technical Account Engineer (MSP), you will oversee the full lifecycle of client technology: from initial discovery, solution design, and SOW scoping, to hands-on project delivery, ongoing infrastructure roadmap reviews, and high-level escalation engineering. We back our team with direct leadership mentorship, company-paid certifications, and a culture that values engineering craftsmanship and ownership.

* Sales Handoff: Own the formal technical handoff from sales into engineering delivery to guarantee scope fidelity and eliminate assumptions.

* Health Reviews & Roadmapping: Conduct annual IT assessments, evaluating cloud security posture, hardware lifecycles, system performance, and more.

* Proactive Gap Remediation: Analyze recurring operational tickets to diagnose chronic IT issues, proposing technical solutions rather than temporary workarounds.

* Escalated Consultation: Advise clients and support teammates through urgent technical dilemmas, compliance changes, disaster scenarios, and business expansion needs.



3. Escalation & Support Engineering (L2/L3)

.

.

title: Clinical Operations Manager – Registered Nurse
description:
Clinical Operations Manager – Registered Nurse



Home Health Experience Required



Full-Time Remote Position | Philippines-Based | U.S. Eastern Time Hours



Zeabe is a growing non-medical home care agency based in Delaware, USA. We provide dependable in-home care services and are building the clinical and operational systems needed to support continued growth while maintaining quality, compliance, and excellent client care.



We are looking for an experienced Registered Nurse with genuine Home Health/Home Care clinical operations experience to join us as our Clinical Operations Manager.



Please Read Before Applying



This is not a Virtual Assistant, Healthcare VA, Medical VA, Medical Receptionist, or general administrative position.



To be considered for this role, you must:



Be a licensed Registered Nurse.

Have worked professionally as an RN.

Have direct experience in a Home Health, Home Care, Private Duty, or comparable in-home care environment.

Have meaningful experience managing, coordinating, supervising, or overseeing clinical operations.

Have been responsible for ensuring other people complete required clinical work, documentation, visits, or deadlines.



If your experience is primarily administrative or Virtual Assistant work, even within healthcare, this position is unlikely to be the right fit.



Likewise, holding an RN license alone is not enough. We are specifically looking for someone who has used their nursing background within Home Health/Home Care and understands the operational side of delivering care in the home.



About the Role



The Clinical Operations Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operational execution of Zeabe's clinical services.



The role ensures clients move smoothly from referral through admission, ongoing supervision, recertification, required clinical visits, documentation, and ongoing service delivery while maintaining accurate records, timely follow-up, and regulatory compliance.



You will work closely with our Clinical Director and serve as the operational leader behind the clinical function.



While the Clinical Director owns overall clinical standards, quality, and clinical leadership, the Clinical Operations Manager owns much of the coordination, execution, monitoring, accountability, and follow-through required to make sure clinical work actually gets completed correctly and on time.



You will work across:



Clinical Support Team

Staffing Coordinator

PRN Registered Nurses

Client admissions

Recertifications

Supervisory visits

Clinical documentation

Clinical scheduling and assignments

Compliance-related follow-up

Operational tracking and reporting



This is primarily a Clinical Operations Management position, not a bedside nursing role.



However, your RN background is essential because you must understand the clinical work you are coordinating, recognize when something does not look right, communicate effectively with nurses, identify potential clinical risks, and understand what needs to be escalated.



Primary Objective



Build and operate a reliable clinical operating system that consistently delivers timely, compliant, accurate, and well-coordinated care.



What You Will Be Responsible For

Coordinate clinical operations from referral and admission through ongoing supervision and service delivery.

Ensure admissions, recertifications, supervisory visits, documentation, and follow-up activities are completed accurately and on time.

Maintain accurate, complete, and compliant clinical records across required systems.

Lead the Clinical Support Team and Staffing Coordinator to deliver consistent operational outcomes.

Coordinate PRN Registered Nurse assignments and monitor completion of required clinical activities.

Identify operational risks, resolve process gaps, and appropriately escalate clinical concerns.

Maintain clear visibility over outstanding clinical work so we know what needs to be completed, who owns it, when it is due, and what requires escalation.

The Experience We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who has actually worked inside Home Health or Home Care clinical operations.



Your experience may include areas such as:



Home Health or Home Care clinical operations

Managing or coordinating field nurses

Admissions or Start of Care processes

Recertifications

Supervisory or reassessment visits

Plans of Care

Clinical documentation review

Chart audits

Clinical compliance

Quality assurance

Tracking required clinical visits

Managing overdue documentation

Coordinating nurses and clinical support staff

Correcting incomplete clinical records

Following up on missed clinical requirements

Clinical scheduling

Home Health EMR/EHR systems

Medicaid, Medicare, VA, Private Duty, or other regulated home-based care environments



You do not need to have performed every item on this list.



What matters is that you have genuine clinical operations experience, rather than simply providing administrative support to people who managed clinical operations.



What This Role Really Requires



This position requires much more than maintaining a task list.



You will be expected to know:



What needs to be completed.

Who is responsible for completing it.

What is currently outstanding.

What is overdue.

What does not appear accurate.

What needs follow-up.

What needs escalation.

What recurring problems need a better system.



If a required nursing visit has not happened, we expect you to notice.



If documentation is incomplete, we expect you to identify it.



If someone tells you something is being handled but it remains unresolved, we expect you to follow it through.



If the same problem keeps occurring, we expect you to help determine why and improve the underlying process.



Leadership and Accountability



We are not looking for someone who simply waits to receive assignments.



The successful person will be comfortable:



Taking ownership of operational outcomes.

Directing and coordinating other team members.

Checking whether work has actually been completed.

Following up when deadlines are missed.

Addressing incomplete or inaccurate clinical documentation.

Asking questions when information does not appear correct.

Holding nurses and support team members accountable for agreed requirements.

Maintaining urgency around important clinical work.

Escalating concerns rather than allowing them to remain unresolved.

Following an issue through until it is fully closed.

Improving processes when the same problem repeatedly occurs.



You should be comfortable having a conversation such as:



"This was due yesterday and has not been completed. What is preventing completion, and when will it be finished?"



You can be professional and respectful while still being clear and firm about expectations.



This Role Is Likely a Good Fit for You If...

You are an RN who has genuinely worked in Home Health/Home Care.

You understand clinical operations beyond simply providing nursing care.

You have coordinated, supervised, or managed nurses or clinical support staff.

You naturally take ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do next.

You notice when a required visit, signature, document, date, or clinical item is missing.

You do not assume something has been completed just because someone says they are working on it.

You continue following up until an issue is completely resolved.

You are comfortable checking other people's work.

You address missed deadlines rather than avoiding uncomfortable conversations.

You work with a sense of urgency while maintaining accuracy.

You enjoy bringing structure and order to complicated clinical workflows.

You prefer clear standards, documented processes, and measurable outcomes.

You can quickly explain the current status of important outstanding items.

You question information when it appears incomplete or inconsistent.

You enjoy improving systems so the same operational problems do not continue happening.





This Role Is Probably Not for You If...

Your healthcare experience is primarily as a Virtual Assistant or Healthcare VA.

You have never worked professionally as a Registered Nurse.

You hold an RN license but have never used it professionally in Home Health/Home Care.

Your nursing background is exclusively bedside hospital nursing with no meaningful Home Health/Home Care operational experience.

You have supported a Clinical Manager but have never personally been accountable for clinical operational outcomes.

You prefer receiving clearly defined individual tasks rather than owning a process.

You avoid following up with people when deadlines are missed.

You are uncomfortable checking another nurse's documentation or work.

You tend to accept that something is being handled without verifying completion.

You regularly need your manager to tell you what to do next.

You dislike detailed documentation, compliance requirements, or structured processes.

You prioritize avoiding uncomfortable conversations over addressing an important missed requirement.

You tend to start many things but struggle to consistently close them.



Required Qualifications



You must have:



An active Registered Nurse license.

Professional experience working as an RN.

Direct Home Health, Home Care, Private Duty, or comparable in-home care experience.

Clinical operations experience.

Experience coordinating, supervising, or managing nurses and/or clinical support personnel.

Experience managing documentation, clinical visits, deadlines, follow-up, or compliance requirements.

Strong written and spoken English.

Excellent attention to detail and documentation accuracy.

Confidence following up on late, incomplete, or inaccurate work.

The ability to distinguish routine operational issues from matters requiring clinical escalation.

Experience using healthcare technology, EHR/EMR software, Home Health software, or comparable clinical systems.

Strong working knowledge of spreadsheets and cloud-based business applications.

The ability to work independently and take ownership.

Availability to work the required U.S. Eastern Time schedule.



Preferred Experience



The following experience would be particularly valuable:



U.S. Home Health experience

U.S. healthcare experience

Medicaid

VA Community Care

Medicare-certified Home Health

Private Duty/Home Care

Quality Assurance

Clinical compliance

Chart auditing

Managing remote or offshore clinical teams

AlayaCare or comparable Home Health software



These are preferred rather than mandatory unless otherwise stated above.



Systems and Technology



You may work with systems including:



AlayaCare

Microsoft Teams

SharePoint

Microsoft Excel

Microsoft Word



Front

Aircall

Trainual

Zoom

Claude



You are not expected to have prior experience with every system.



We are much more interested in whether you are comfortable learning technology, using structured systems consistently, and maintaining accurate information.



Working Hours



This is a full-time remote position working:



8:00 AM to 4:30 PM U.S. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday



Please consider the corresponding Philippine overnight working hours before applying.



Compensation



USD $1,800 to $2,400 per month



Compensation will depend on directly relevant experience, including:



Home Health/Home Care experience

Clinical Operations Management experience

RN experience

Leadership experience

U.S. or PH healthcare experience

Overall fit for the position





How to Apply (Read Carefully)



We use structured systems and automation heavily, so attention to detail matters — starting with your application.



Step 1: Apply through OnlineJobs.ph



Step 2: In your application message, mention this EXACT role: Clinical Operations



Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be considered.

title: Media Buyer - GoHighLevel (GHL), Google Ads & Facebook Ads
description:
Degalo Digital is hiring a reliable, experienced media buyer for ongoing remote work supporting local service businesses.



The portfolio contains 40+ client ad accounts. Most work is for Ireland, with potential campaigns in the UK, Australia and other countries. Our video editor supplies creative assets; you will turn clear briefs into correctly targeted, well-organised campaigns and keep accounts checked daily. Training on our workflow and client requirements will be provided, but you must already be confident using Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads and GoHighLevel (GHL).



PAY AND HOURS

PHP25,000-PHP30,000 per month, depending on verified experience and the agreed workload. Expected workload is around 2-3 hours per day, approximately 14-21 hours per week. Tell us your requested monthly rate and the daily coverage you can reliably provide.



Work flexibly across the day, including weekends, with daily account checks. There is no fixed 9-to-5 shift. We may send a complete advert brief at different times; adverts should normally be uploaded/published as instructed within approximately 8-12 hours, with reasonable flexibility. Tell us how you will reliably provide this coverage in Ireland time (Europe/Dublin). Campaign volume varies; work will be prioritised within the agreed hours, and additional workload or availability must be agreed separately. We will review capacity and responsibilities after the initial onboarding period.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Use GoHighLevel to check that campaign leads reach the correct client sub-account, contact record and pipeline, and that existing forms, workflows and follow-up automations work as intended. Troubleshoot lead-flow issues and flag problems promptly.

- Publish supplied adverts and set up or update Meta and Google Ads campaigns from client briefs. For example: upload these new adverts to the specified client account, check all settings, publish as instructed and confirm completion.

- Check the correct client account, page, creative, copy, destination/lead form, conversion event, approved budget, schedule and location targeting before launch.

- Monitor account health, spend pacing, disapprovals, tracking problems, lead volume and cost per lead daily; flag problems clearly and promptly.

- Make agreed optimisations and recommendations using campaign data. Follow approval limits for changes to budgets and strategy.

- Maintain a simple account/task log, give brief daily updates, and complete two deeper performance reviews each week within the agreed hours.

- Work accurately across 40+ accounts and raise capacity conflicts early rather than missing launches or making rushed changes.



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

- Practical, hands-on GoHighLevel (GHL) experience is required alongside
/Meta Ads AND Google Ads. Be comfortable with contacts, pipelines/opportunities, forms, workflows, lead integrations and checking automated follow-up.

- At least 2 years of hands-on paid advertising experience, with strong practical experience in BOTH Meta/Facebook Ads and Google Ads.

- Demonstrable results from campaigns you personally managed. Local service lead generation and agency/multi-account experience are particularly relevant.

- Confidence with Meta campaign/ad set/ad structure and Google Search campaign structure, keywords, negative keywords, conversion tracking and location settings.

- Strong geographical research and targeting skills, particularly for Ireland. You must be able to locate places such as Galway correctly, distinguish city/county/service-area instructions, verify radii and exclusions, and check the correct country. Apply the same care to the UK, Australia and other markets.

- Clear written English, reliable internet, attention to detail and dependable daily communication.



HOW TO APPLY

Use the subject: DEGALO MEDIA BUYER - Your Name

Include:

1. Your relevant experience, stating how long you have personally worked with Meta Ads, Google Ads and GoHighLevel, and how many accounts you manage at once.

2. Two relevant campaign examples, ideally one Meta and one Google. Include the objective, country, date range, approximate spend, results/CPL or CPA, and your own role. Anonymise client details and hide private customer data.

3. Describe one GoHighLevel lead-generation setup you personally handled: how leads entered the CRM, pipeline/workflow routing, automated follow-up and how you tested it. Hide private contact/client details.

4. Your available daily working/check-in windows in Ireland time, including weekends, current capacity and earliest start date.

5. Your requested monthly pay within PHP25,000-PHP30,000 and whether you propose closer to 2 or 3 hours per day.

6. A 3-5 minute Loom or similar screen recording demonstrating that you can prepare an advert correctly. Use an anonymised existing example or a draft/demo setup for a hypothetical roofing client serving Galway, Ireland. title: Framer/Figma UI/UX Designer
description:

The design must be 100% original and custom-built. We will not accept:



* Templates or themes from the Framer Marketplace or any other template source

* Lightly modified or rebranded templates

* Copies of the existing site layout



Your role is design and site structure. We provide all copy and brand assets (logo, colors, photos, video). Our in-house team will enter content once your templates are built.



Design workflow

You can design in Figma first and then build in Framer, or design directly in Framer. Either way, the final deliverable must be a fully built Framer site with the CMS configured.



Scope of work



UI/UX design of all page templates, desktop and mobile:

* Home page

* Service page template

* Service area / location page template

* About

* Contact

* Blog listing and blog post template

* Photo/video gallery (project showcase)

* Legal pages (privacy policy, terms)

* 404 page



Built in Framer with a clean, reusable component and style system (colors, type scale, buttons, sections) so new pages stay consistent.



CMS setup for scalability, with collections for blog posts, services, service areas, and gallery/projects, structured so our team can add pages without touching the design.



SEO-ready structure

* Correct heading hierarchy: one H1 per page, logical H2/H3 nesting

* CMS fields for meta title, meta description, and image alt text



Performance optimized for strong Google PageSpeed Insights scores on mobile and desktop: optimized images, minimal heavy animation, efficient font loading.



Conversion-focused design: clear CTAs, click-to-call, lead forms, and trust signals such as reviews, certifications, warranties, and financing.



Requirements



2+ years of web design experience, with at least 3 live Framer sites in your portfolio

Strong understanding of responsive design, UX, and conversion best practices

Hands-on experience with the Framer CMS

Working knowledge of on-page SEO and site speed optimization

Figma experience is a plus

Experience designing for local service businesses (home services, contractors, etc.) is a strong plus

Clear written English and availability for at least 2–3 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time



Deliverables



A complete Framer project with all templates (desktop, tablet, mobile) and the CMS configured

A style/component guide inside the project

Figma design files, if you design in Figma

A short video walkthrough showing our team how to add pages and CMS items

Up to 2 rounds of revisions per milestone



Ownership

All design files, assets, and the Framer project are owned by us. Project details are confidential.



Timeline and budget



Estimated timeline: 4-5 weeks

Budget: $1,800 - $2,300 fixed, depending on experience, paid by milestone:

* Design direction and home page approved

* Remaining templates approved

* Framer build and CMS delivered



To apply, please send:



Links to 2–3 live Framer sites you designed

Your fixed-price quote and estimated timeline

A short note on how you’d approach the design of a roofing company website differently from a typical contractor site



Applications without live Framer links will not be considered.

title: # Cold Calling & Sales Role-Play Coach — 1-on-1 Training
description:
I am looking for an experienced **Sales Coach / Sales Trainer / Cold Calling Trainer** to work with me one-on-one.



I am **not looking for someone to make cold calls for me**. I am looking for someone who will **personally train and coach me so I become much better at cold calling and selling.**



The right person should be comfortable actively coaching me, challenging me, correcting me, and doing realistic role-plays with me.



## What I Want to Learn



I want to become confident and effective on the phone, including:



* How to start a cold call confidently

* How to create and deliver a strong pitch

* What exactly to say and how to say it

* How to sound confident, natural, and conversational

* How to avoid sounding nervous, robotic, or overly scripted

* How to ask good questions

* How to keep the prospect engaged

* How to identify the prospect's needs

* How to transition naturally into the offer

* How to ask for the appointment or sale

* How to handle rejection

* How to handle difficult prospects

* How to overcome common objections

* How to think on my feet when the prospect says something unexpected

* How to become more comfortable and confident through repeated practice



## I Want REAL Role-Playing



This is extremely important.



I want you to actually **play the role of the prospect** while I practice calling you.



For example, you might act like a prospect who says:



> "I'm not interested."



Then I respond.



You challenge me again.



You might say:



> "Just send me an
."



Or:



> "We already have someone."



Or:



> "How much does it cost?"



Or:



> "Where did you get my number?"



Or give me another realistic objection.



I want you to **challenge me instead of making the role-play easy.**



After the role-play, I want you to explain:



* What I did well

* What I did poorly

* Where I sounded uncertain

* What I should have said instead

* How I could improve my wording

* How I could sound more confident

* Where I talked too much

* Where I should have asked a question

* Where I should have pushed back

* How I could have moved the conversation toward an appointment or sale



Then I want to **do the role-play again** and apply your corrections.



## I Want a Coach Who Will Push Me



Please don't simply tell me that everything sounds good.



I want someone who will respectfully **challenge me and point out my weaknesses**.



If my pitch is weak, tell me.



If I sound nervous, tell me.



If I'm talking too much, stop me.



If I'm asking the wrong question, explain what I should ask.



If I'm avoiding asking for the sale, challenge me to actually ask.



The goal is for me to improve through **repetition, feedback, and realistic practice.**



## Help Me Build My Pitch



I would also like help developing and improving my actual sales pitch.



You should be able to help me:



1. Understand the product/service I'm selling

2. Create a strong opening

3. Develop the pitch

4. Create good discovery questions

5. Prepare responses to common objections

6. Practice the entire conversation

7. Adjust the script so it sounds natural rather than memorized

8. Practice until I can deliver it confidently



## Experience I'm Looking For



You should have significant experience in one or more of the following:



* Cold calling

* B2B sales

* B2C sales

* Sales training

* Sales coaching

* Sales management

* SDR/BDR training

* Business development

* Appointment setting

* Closing

* Objection handling

* Phone sales

* Sales role-playing

* Sales performance coaching



**Teaching/coaching ability is very important.**



Being a good salesperson alone is not enough. You need to be able to **teach another person how to sell.**



## Sample Video — VERY IMPORTANT



If you have a video showing yourself doing any of the following, please send it with your application:



* Sales coaching

* Cold-call training

* Role-playing a sales call

* Teaching someone how to sell

* Demonstrating a cold call

* Handling objections

* Training salespeople



It does **not** have to be a professionally produced video.



I mainly want to see **how you actually teach and coach.**



If you don't have an existing video, you may record a short sample explaining how you would coach someone through a cold call.



## Please Include Your Desired Rate



Please tell me **how much you are asking per hour** for this type of one-on-one coaching.



Do not simply write "negotiable."



Please provide your actual requested hourly rate.



## Please Answer These Questions



1. How many years of sales experience do you have?

2. How many years of sales training/coaching experience do you have?

3. Have you personally trained people to cold call?

4. Have you done live sales role-play with students or salespeople?

5. What types of products/services have you sold?

6. What type of sales were you involved in — B2B, B2C, high-ticket, appointment setting, closing, etc.?

7. How do you normally structure a one-on-one sales coaching session?

8. How do you teach someone to sound more confident on the phone?

9. How do you teach objection handling?

10. Are you comfortable challenging the student rather than simply giving encouragement?

11. Do you have a sample video? **Please provide the link.**

12. What is your desired hourly rate?



## Top 3 Skills



Please make sure your profile/application highlights these three skills:



**1. Cold Calling & Sales Training**



**2. Sales Role-Play & Objection Handling**



**3. Sales Pitch, Confidence & Communication Coaching**



I am looking for someone interested in **ongoing one-on-one coaching**, not just a one-time session.



Please apply with your experience, sample video if available, and desired hourly rate.

I am looking for someone who can determine **what is actually limiting the quality of my voice** and then develop exercises and techniques specifically for those areas.



## REMOTE ONE-ON-ONE TRAINING



Training will be conducted remotely through live video sessions.



You should be comfortable:



- Demonstrating exercises through video

- Listening carefully to my voice

- Watching my technique

- Correcting me in real time

- Explaining exactly what I am doing incorrectly

- Demonstrating the correct technique

- Having me repeat an exercise until I understand it

- Giving me exercises to practice between sessions

I am looking for a **personalized training program**, not a generic lesson plan.



If there are certain things that genuinely require an in-person professional, I can arrange that separately locally. The primary training will be done remotely.



## IMPORTANT — REMOTE AUDIO QUALITY & VOICE ASSESSMENT



Because this is voice training, **being able to accurately hear my voice is extremely important.**



I am not looking for someone who simply knows how to conduct a Zoom call.



You should understand the limitations of remote voice training and know how to get the **clearest and most accurate representation of the voice possible through technology.**



You should be able to recommend the best setup for our sessions, including:



- Which platform you recommend for voice training — **Zoom, Google Meet,
, or another platform — and why**

- What type of microphone you recommend

- Whether I should use headphones or a headset

- How I should position myself in relation to the microphone

- What audio settings you recommend

- Whether any platform features such as **noise suppression, echo cancellation, automatic gain control, compression, or other audio processing** could interfere with accurately evaluating the voice

- Whether any settings should be changed or disabled during voice training

- Whether you recommend live sessions alone or also using **high-quality voice recordings**

- What type of recordings you would want me to provide before our first session

- How you distinguish actual characteristics of my voice from artifacts caused by the microphone, room, software, or internet connection



### I want you to be able to hear my actual voice.

You should have a thoughtful answer to this rather than simply saying, "Zoom is fine."



## VIDEO TEACHING EXPERIENCE



I am particularly interested in seeing **how you actually teach**, not just hearing about your qualifications.



If available, please provide a **short video of yourself actually teaching or coaching someone's voice.**



I would especially like to see how you:



- Listen to a student's voice

- Identify a problem

- Explain what you hear

- Demonstrate an exercise

- Correct the student

- Give feedback

- Adjust your approach based on the individual student



A singing performance or promotional video is **not as useful to me** as a video showing you actually teaching.



If you do not have a teaching video available, please explain your previous experience conducting one-on-one voice training.

3. Explain what you are hearing and why it matters

Professional voice coaching, vocal training, singing instruction, speech/voice training, or related professional experience is strongly preferred.



A strong understanding of **vocal/throat anatomy and how the voice physically works** is particularly important.



You should also be able to explain the **reason behind the exercises** you recommend.

title: Affiliate Content Manager
description:
[IMPORTANT] To apply, please fill in the application form here: 



About Crafti



Crafti is a matcha brand selling in the USA and Singapore. We are a small and fast team that prioritises output and growth. We currently have over 5 remote Filipino team members and are proud to be a remote-first company.



The Role



We're looking for an Affiliate Content Manager to grow and run our network of affiliate creators: finding the right creators, getting them excited about Crafti, and making sure the content they post actually makes people buy.



This is an analytical role, not a creative one. You don't need years of experience. What matters is that you enjoy pulling videos apart to understand why some sell and others don't, and that you keep using what you learn to make the next round better.



You'll thrive here if you:



- Watch a TikTok or Reel and naturally break down why it worked or didn't: the hook, the first 3 seconds, the format, the comments

- Care more about whether a video sold the product than whether it looked nice

- Enjoy comparing results, spotting patterns and testing small changes to see what improves

- Can juggle dozens of creator conversations across DMs,
 and WhatsApp without letting anyone slip through the cracks

- Follow up and push things forward rather than wait to be told what's next

- Learn fast and pick up new tools (including AI) on your own



Do not apply if:



- You mainly see yourself as a creative and want to make your own content. This role is about analysing and improving content, not creating it.

- You don't use TikTok or Instagram regularly yourself

- You are uncomfortable being a project manager or following up with people who go quiet

- Your written English is not clear and professional. You will be writing to creators on our behalf.



What You'll Do



- Creator Sourcing: find and reach out to creators whose audience matches ours (women aged 25–35 who are into wellness, pilates and healthy routines)

- Affiliate Management: onboard creators, send free product, agree on terms and keep every creator moving from "interested" to "posted"

- Content Briefing: write clear briefs based on what has actually worked for us and what is trending right now

- Content Review: review creator content before it goes live and give specific feedback to improve it

- Performance Analysis: track how every post performs (views, clicks, sales), work out what the winners have in common, and feed that back into the next briefs

- Trend Watching: spot formats and trends we should test, and back up your suggestions with examples of how they are performing



What We Are Looking For



Skills:



- Strong understanding of short-form content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) and what makes people buy

- Organised: comfortable keeping trackers in Google Sheets or similar

- Clear, friendly written English

- Comfortable with tech tools and AI

- Bonus (not required): experience with influencer outreach, product gifting



Traits (these matter more than your CV):



- Urgency and ownership: today's task is today's responsibility and I get it done

- Proactive communicator: if something might go wrong, I flag it early

- Has opinions: I want to suggest a better way, and I back it up with evidence





Details



This is a remote contract role based in the Philippines.



Remuneration: PHP 75,000 per month



Commitment: Contract role with the option to extend if found to be suitable

Hours: Philippine business hours, Monday to Friday, 9:30am – 6:30pm, with flexibility to reply to creators outside these hours

title: Bookkeeping Lead
description:
About the Opportunity



We are looking for an experienced, detail-oriented, and proactive Bookkeeping Lead to oversee bookkeeping operations, maintain the accuracy of financial records, and ensure consistent, reliable financial processes across the organization.

In this role, you’ll take ownership of the bookkeeping workflow, oversee the review and reconciliation of financial transactions, monitor the quality of bookkeeping work, and help ensure that financial records are accurate, complete, and properly documented. You’ll also coordinate with bookkeeping staff, address discrepancies, establish clear procedures, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and accountability.



This is a hands-on leadership position for someone who combines strong bookkeeping and accounting knowledge with excellent organizational, analytical, and team coordination skills. We’re looking for someone who can manage daily priorities, identify issues before they become larger problems, and ensure that bookkeeping tasks are completed accurately and on time.



Key Responsibilities



Bookkeeping Operations & Financial Oversight

- Oversee day-to-day bookkeeping activities, including transaction recording, expense tracking, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and financial record maintenance.

- Ensure financial transactions are properly categorized, accurately recorded, and assigned to the correct accounts and reporting periods.

- Oversee bank reconciliations, credit card reconciliations, payment records, and other assigned account reconciliations.

- Review bookkeeping entries, invoices, receipts, expense reports, and supporting documentation for completeness and accuracy.

- Monitor outstanding transactions, unreconciled balances, missing documentation, and other items requiring follow-up.

- Ensure bookkeeping tasks are completed according to established procedures, deadlines, and quality standards.

- Maintain organized financial records and ensure supporting documentation is readily available for review.



Team Leadership & Workflow Management

- Coordinate and oversee the daily workload of bookkeeping staff to ensure tasks are completed accurately and on schedule.

- Assign responsibilities, establish priorities, and monitor progress across bookkeeping activities.

- Review completed work and provide guidance when corrections or additional documentation are required.

- Support team members in resolving complex bookkeeping issues and understanding proper accounting procedures.

- Establish clear expectations for accuracy, productivity, documentation, and accountability.

- Identify training needs and help team members strengthen their bookkeeping knowledge and technical skills.

- Communicate workflow priorities, outstanding issues, and operational updates to management.

- Promote a culture of ownership, attention to detail, continuous improvement, and reliable follow-through.



Financial Review, Auditing & Quality Control

- Conduct or oversee periodic reviews of bookkeeping records to verify accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

- Identify duplicate transactions, incorrect classifications, missing entries, mathematical errors, and unsupported expenses.

- Investigate discrepancies by tracing transactions to bank statements, invoices, receipts, payment confirmations, and other source documents.

- Ensure identified errors are corrected appropriately and that adjustments are supported by adequate documentation.

- Monitor recurring bookkeeping errors and implement measures to reduce repeat issues.

- Maintain review checklists, quality-control procedures, and documentation standards.

- Verify that previously identified discrepancies and audit findings have been resolved.

- Escalate significant financial irregularities, unresolved discrepancies, or potential control weaknesses to management.



Reconciliation & Month-End Close Coordination

- Oversee the completion and review of bank, credit card, and other account reconciliations.

- Monitor unreconciled transactions and ensure differences are investigated and documented.

- Coordinate month-end and period-end bookkeeping activities to support accurate financial reporting.

- Review account balances and supporting schedules for unusual fluctuations or inconsistencies.

- Ensure outstanding transactions, adjustments, and reconciliation items are tracked through resolution.

- Coordinate with relevant team members to obtain missing information and resolve discrepancies before reporting deadlines.

- Help ensure financial records are complete and ready for management review or external accounting support.



Process Improvement & Internal Controls

- Develop, document, and maintain standardized bookkeeping procedures and workflows.

- Identify bottlenecks, repetitive tasks, and process gaps that affect accuracy or productivity.

- Recommend improvements to transaction processing, reconciliation procedures, documentation practices, and reporting workflows.

- Strengthen internal controls to support proper documentation, authorization, and traceability of financial transactions.

- Improve tracking systems and reporting methods to provide better visibility into task completion, outstanding issues, and team performance.

- Help implement accounting software features, spreadsheet tools, and automation opportunities that reduce manual work and prevent errors.

- Monitor the effectiveness of implemented improvements and adjust procedures when necessary.



Reporting & Management Communication

- Prepare regular bookkeeping status reports covering completed work, outstanding reconciliations, unresolved discrepancies, and upcoming deadlines.

- Provide management with visibility into bookkeeping accuracy, workflow performance, recurring errors, and operational concerns.

- Maintain documentation of financial reviews, corrective actions, and process improvements.

- Track key performance indicators such as reconciliation completion, error rates, overdue tasks, and outstanding items.

- Communicate material discrepancies and operational risks promptly.

- Support management with reliable financial records and organized documentation for decision-making.



Confidentiality & Professional Standards

- Maintain strict confidentiality when handling financial records, banking information, payroll-related information, and sensitive business data.

- Ensure team members follow established privacy, security, and financial documentation procedures.

- Maintain appropriate access controls and follow authorization requirements for financial adjustments.

- Promote accuracy, integrity, transparency, and accountability across bookkeeping operations.

- Ensure financial corrections and adjustments are properly supported, documented, and approved when required.



What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is analytical, dependable, organized, and capable of leading a bookkeeping function while maintaining high standards of financial accuracy.

Ideal candidates will have:

- Several years of experience in bookkeeping, accounting operations, financial reconciliation, or related financial  administration, including experience reviewing the work of others or coordinating bookkeeping activities.

- A strong understanding of bookkeeping principles, debits and credits, general ledger accounts, and financial transaction recording.

- Hands-on experience with bank reconciliations, accounts payable, accounts receivable, expense tracking, and financial record maintenance.

- Experience reviewing financial records, identifying discrepancies, and ensuring corrections are properly documented.

- Previous experience supervising, coordinating, or mentoring bookkeeping staff.

- Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly when investigating complex financial discrepancies.

- Proficiency with accounting software such as QuickBooks, Xero, or similar platforms.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for financial analysis, tracking, and reporting.

- The ability to establish procedures, monitor performance, and hold team members accountable for accurate and timely work.

- Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain financial issues and provide constructive feedback.

- The ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and collaborate effectively with a remote team.

- A strong commitment to confidentiality, accuracy, process improvement, and professional integrity.

- An accounting degree, bookkeeping certification, or relevant professional training is a plus.



What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means ensuring that bookkeeping operations are accurate, organized, efficient, and consistently completed to a high standard.

You’ll help ensure:

- Daily bookkeeping tasks are completed accurately and within established deadlines.

- Financial transactions are properly recorded, categorized, and supported by documentation.

- Bank reconciliations and other account reviews are completed on schedule.

- Errors, missing records, and discrepancies are identified and resolved promptly.

- Bookkeeping staff understand their responsibilities and meet established quality standards.

- Month-end bookkeeping activities are completed in an organized and timely manner.

- Financial records remain accurate, traceable, and ready for management review.

- Standardized procedures improve consistency and reduce recurring errors.

- Management receives timely updates on bookkeeping performance and unresolved issues.

- The bookkeeping team operates with clear accountability, reliable workflows, and a continuous-improvement mindset.



How to Apply

If you enjoy leading teams, improving financial processes, solving bookkeeping problems, and ensuring the accuracy of financial records, we’d love to hear from you.



Please submit your resume highlighting your experience in bookkeeping, accounting operations, financial reconciliation, and team leadership. Include the accounting software and financial tools you have used, along with examples of how you have improved bookkeeping accuracy, managed workflows, resolved discrepancies, or helped a team meet financial deadlines.

In addition to MPHQ, Accordant's diverse and growing operating company portfolio includes Mend Strategies, Modern Amenities, AIMS Group, and Break Through Closing — each reflecting the firm's approach of partnering with founders to scale businesses through strategic growth, operational excellence, and talent development.



Position Overview:



The SDR Manager will build MPHQ's outbound sales engine from the ground up — Accordant Capital's healthcare compliance platform — and own the revenue it produces. This manager will recruit and ramp a high-performing team, establish the sales motion, and create the operating discipline required to scale from an initial pilot pod to a 10+ rep organization. This is a net-new logo acquisition role — the focus is winning first-time customers, not expanding or renewing existing accounts."



The ideal candidate has done this before, can bring proven talent, and can demonstrate a track record of turning outbound teams into predictable revenue engines. You are a builder, not a caretaker — someone who has launched an outbound sales function from scratch, recruited high-performing sellers, and built the operating system that turns activity into predictable revenue.

Build the Program

●	Recruit and ramp an initial 5-person pilot pod, then scale based on demonstrated production and unit economics.

●	Tap your own bench and network of proven SDRs, BDRs, inside sales reps, or closers who can accelerate time-to-productivity, subject to the Company's standard hiring process.

●	Build a repeatable onboarding and ramp program that shortens time-to-first-opportunity and time-to-quota.

●	Establish a rigorous coaching rhythm using live calls/recordings, with regular feedback on discovery, active listening, gatekeeper navigation, objection handling, and closing.

●	Own retention and performance management, keeping top producers engaged and accountable.
