●	Track record of winning net-new, first-time customers (new logos) in a competitive or incumbent-vendor sales cycle — not primarily account expansion or renewal-based selling.

●	Experience closing larger, high-level, or enterprise/multi-stakeholder deals, in addition to high-volume outbound activity.

●	Own team targets for qualified opportunities, net-new customer acquisition, closed revenue, and quota attainment.

●	Build and execute outbound calling cadences into US provider offices — physician, dental, long-term care, veterinary, and other non-acute practices.

●	Ensure reps can position the Company's value on cost savings, compliance coverage, and service reliability, and handle price and incumbent-vendor objections.

●	Personally inspect the sales motion and intervene where activity, conversion, or close rates break down.

Pipeline, Process & Enablement

●	Create and maintain call guides, discovery frameworks, objection-handling guides, and playbooks.

●	Oversee call monitoring and QA to ensure consistent, professional, compliant customer interactions.

●	Use CRM, sales-engagement/sequencing, dialer, call-coaching, and reporting tools to drive transparency and accountability.

●	Monitor pipeline health, stage conversion, time-to-close, and bottlenecks; turn findings into specific process changes.

●	Maintain disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.



Performance, Reporting & Unit Economics

●	Track daily, weekly, and monthly KPIs — dials, connects, conversations, qualified opportunities, conversion, closed revenue, and quota attainment.

●	Own the sales funnel from activity through revenue and establish clear baseline conversion metrics.

●	Measure and improve unit economics, including cost per qualified opportunity, cost per acquisition, revenue per rep, and payback.

●	Use performance data to determine when to adjust the people, process, proposition, or investment level before scaling.

●	Provide concise, actionable reporting to US executive leadership and participate in strategic reviews.



Required Qualifications

●	5+ years in B2B outbound and consultative sales with a documented record of quota attainment, including hands-on prospecting and closing.

●	3+ years leading SDR, inside sales, or comparable outbound teams.

●	Required: demonstrated experience building and scaling an outbound sales function from zero — not simply managing an established team.

●	Documented track record with specific, quotable results from a team built and scaled to consistent quota attainment.

●	Personally recruited and ramped sales talent; able to explain the rep profile, sourcing strategy, hiring bar, and time-to-productivity.

●	Existing network or bench of proven sales talent that can be activated for the initial team is strongly preferred.

●	Strong command of CRM, sales engagement/sequencing, dialer, call-recording/coaching, and reporting tools; able to independently build cadences, scripts, QA, and performance reporting. Salesforce experience preferred.

●	Data-driven operator who can diagnose where conversion breaks down and adapt the playbook accordingly.

●	Consultative selling philosophy — leads with discovery, listens before recommending, and can coach this approach rather than simply enforce scripts.

●	Exceptional spoken and written English with a warm, credible phone presence for a US audience.

●	Entrepreneurial mindset and comfort operating in a fast-paced, quota-driven environment.

●	Reliable remote work setup with stable high-speed internet, headset, and backup power/internet; full overlap with US business hours (CST).



Nice-To-Have

●	Experience selling compliance, waste, insurance, SaaS, BPO, or other recurring B2B services.

●	Experience designing tiered SDR incentive and commission plans.

Compensation & Benefits

Company as it deems necessary; details will be stated in the employment contract.

Role Overview



We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Electrical Engineer to join our team. This role involves electrical design, project coordination, system analysis, and technical documentation. The successful candidate will work closely with project managers, site teams, and clients to ensure accurate planning, safe installations, and seamless execution of all electrical works—from concept design to project completion.



Key Responsibilities

Electrical Engineering & Design



Electrical System Design: Develop, review, and interpret electrical plans, schematics, and load calculations.

Technical Specifications: Prepare detailed specifications, diagrams, SLDs (single-line diagrams), and layout drawings.

Material & Equipment Selection: Determine appropriate electrical components, materials, and equipment required for projects.

Compliance & Standards: Ensure designs meet electrical codes, safety standards, and regulatory requirements.



Project Coordination & Client Management



Site Coordination: Work with contractors, site engineers, and electricians to ensure proper installation and site execution.

Client Communication: Liaise with clients to clarify requirements, provide technical updates, and explain engineering decisions.

Documentation: Prepare project reports, progress updates, testing results, QA/QC records, and risk assessments.

Change Management: Document revisions to electrical plans and update load calculations, cost impacts, and schedules accordingly.



Testing, Maintenance & Quality Control



System Testing: Perform testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of electrical systems and equipment.

Preventive Maintenance: Evaluate system performance and recommend maintenance schedules or upgrades.

Safety Compliance: Ensure all electrical work follows safety protocols, lock-out/tag-out procedures, and hazard assessments.



Financial Administration & Office Support



Cost Estimation: Prepare electrical cost estimates, material take-offs, and assist in budget planning.

Invoice & Documentation: Support invoicing, procurement coordination, and inventory updates for electrical materials.

Technical Records: Maintain accurate documentation, permits, and electrical certification records.

Technical Requirements



Electrical Engineering: Proven experience in electrical design, installation supervision, testing, and commissioning.

Codes & Standards: Strong understanding of local electrical codes, NEC/IEC standards, and safety regulations.

Technical Proficiency: Skilled in electrical drafting tools (AutoCAD, Revit MEP, or similar) and testing instruments.

Project Knowledge: Familiarity with construction processes, electrical layouts, and engineering documentation, and project management using Tradify.



Professional Skills



Analytical Ability: Strong problem-solving and technical analysis skills.

Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication for client and contractor coordination.

Organization: Ability to handle multiple projects, documentation, and scheduling tasks efficiently.

Adaptability: Capable of managing both office-based work and technical project duties.



What We Offer



Competitive compensation package

Opportunities to work with clients across Ireland and the UK

Professional development and training programs

Collaborative and supportive remote work environment

Clear career advancement pathways

Exposure to diverse engineering and construction projects

Flexible remote working systems with comprehensive support

title: Direct Response Creative Strategist for Meta Ads (Research & Copy, NOT a Design Role)
description:
About us

We are a direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand selling a women's body-confidence product in several countries. We are a small, fast team. Meta is our main channel and we launch new creatives every week. Creative d
 whether we win or lose, and this role owns the thinking behind it.



What you will do

- Dig into customer research every week: reviews, Reddit, comments under our ads, surveys, and competitor ads in the Meta Ad Library. Pull out the exact words our customers use.

- Turn that research into angles, hooks and concepts. Each one comes with a clear hypothesis: who it is for, what triggers it, and what belief it changes.

- Write ad copy in English: primary texts, headlines, hooks and video scripts (UGC, native, statics).

- Write clear briefs for our video editors and our static ad production: what to show, what to say, and why.

- Every week, read the numbers with us (hook rate, CTR, add-to-cart, CPA, ROAS) and propose the next iterations: what to scale, what to stop, what to test next.

- Keep a clean log of every test and what we learned from it.

- Sometimes build static ads yourself in Canva, Photoshop or Figma. Real design work, not AI-generated images.



What you will NOT do

Launch ads or manage ad accounts. We handle that.



Must have

- At least 1 to 2 years writing ads or doing creative strategy for e-commerce brands on Meta. Show us real ads you worked on.

- Experience with women 45+, health or beauty audiences.

- Excellent written English. Your copy sounds like a real person talking.

- A solid grasp of direct response: awareness levels, hooks, angles, offers.

- You can read an Ads Manager report and explain why an ad works or fails.

- You can build clean static ads yourself. Send 2 to 3 examples.

- You use Claude Code (Claude in the CLI, from the terminal/command line) every day for research and writing. This is mandatory. If you only use ChatGPT or Claude in the browser, this role is not for you.

title: Online Phonics and English Teacher for Kids
description:
CurioKids teaches children aged 4 to 12 in Singapore and Malaysia to read and speak English through live, 1-to-1 online lessons. Every child starts with our Phonics Starter, learning to read sound by sound using the UK Letters and Sounds method, then moves on to our CEFR-aligned English course.



We launch on 2 November 2026 and are building our founding team of teachers. You will be trained directly by our Head of Curriculum, a qualified phonics teacher.



THE ROLE

- Teach live 25-minute 1-to-1 phonics and English lessons to children aged 4 to 12, using our ready-made lesson materials

- Run free trial lessons: a friendly lesson, a quick check of which sounds the child knows, and a short summary for parents

- Write brief notes after every lesson and help prepare progress updates for parents

- Record a short "Meet the Teacher" video for our website, as parents choose their own teacher

- Cover lessons for colleagues when needed

- Follow our safeguarding rules in every lesson

- Join weekly team meetings, training and lesson reviews



SCHEDULE (Philippine time, same as Singapore and Malaysia, so no night shifts)

40 hours a week over 5 days:

- 4 weekdays, 12pm to 9pm, with one weekday off each week (agreed with you so the team is covered every day)

- 1 weekend day of your choice, Saturday or Sunday, 9am to 6pm

Your hours include time for lesson notes, preparation and team meetings, not just teaching.



PAY AND BENEFITS

- Up to USD 600 a month, fixed salary, paid on the 10th of each month for the previous month

- 13th-month payment in December

- Paid training on the CurioKids method before your first lesson

- Ready-made lesson materials, so no unpaid planning time

- Regular pay reviews and a path to Senior Teacher

- Independent contractor agreement



REQUIREMENTS

- TEFL or TESOL certificate (minimum 120 hours)

- At least 1 year teaching children aged 4 to 12, online or in a classroom

- Clear, confident spoken English and a warm, patient manner with young children

- Valid NBI clearance (issued within the last 6 months)

- Laptop or desktop, headset with noise-cancelling microphone and HD webcam

- Stable internet of at least 25 Mbps, plus a backup connection

- Quiet, well-lit space with a plain background



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience teaching phonics (Letters and Sounds, Jolly Phonics or similar)

- Education degree or LET licence

- Experience teaching children from Singapore or Malaysia



HOW TO APPLY

Please send:

1. Your CV

2. Your TEFL or TESOL certificate

3. A 1-minute video introducing yourself as if you were meeting a 5-year-old student



Start your application with the words "Phonics Teacher" so we know you have read this post.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a video interview. Before your interview, you will complete a short challenge:



Write a lesson plan showing how you would teach a 25-minute phonics lesson to a 5-year-old. Please include:

title: Senior Amazon Creative Designer / Creative Lead (Listing Images & A+ Content) – Part-Time to Full-Time
description:
About us

Brightlane is a German Amazon agency. We run PPC and creative for brands selling on Amazon in Europe, the UK and the US, from beauty and personal care to home and kitchen.



The role

As Senior Creative Designer you develop the concepts for our listing images, A+ Content and Brand Stores and guide our designers in executing them. You think in concepts, not just layouts: you turn product facts, reviews and search data into images that sell. You also design key pieces yourself and make sure everything that leaves the team meets our standards.



How we work

For every product we start with research (listing, reviews, competitors), plan the full image set with one clear claim per image and then design in Figma within the brand identity. Depending on the brand, we work with original photos from shoots, AI-generated images or a mix of both. AI is a core part of our process: we use tools like Claude and ChatGPT for research, concepts and image creation. The thinking and the final quality check stay with people.



What you’ll do



- Develop image and A+ concepts from research and turn them into clear briefings for our designers

- Guide and coach 2 designers, review their work and give clear feedback

- Design main images, secondary images, A+ / Premium A+, Brand Stories and Brand Stores yourself

- Set up brand identity templates in Figma and create realistic product scenes with AI and Photoshop

- Plan the content pipeline together with the founders





Must-haves



- 3+ years designing for Amazon or other marketplaces. Portfolio with complete listing image sets and A+ Content required

- Strong concept skills: you can explain why an image sells

- Experience briefing, reviewing or leading other designers

- Expert in Figma and Photoshop, confident working with both shoot photos and AI-generated images

- You use AI intuitively and efficiently in your daily work, from research to image creation, and you know how to make generated images look like real photos

- Very good written English, works independently, takes feedback well

- Reliable internet, own equipment

- Available 9 AM to 1 PM German time (4 to 8 PM PH time, 3 to 7 PM during European summer time)



Nice to have



- Experience with German / EU marketplaces and localized creatives

- Knowledge of Amazon image and content policies

- Experience with Notion and Slack



What we offer



- Start with 20 hours/week, clear path to full-time and Creative Lead

- USD 12 to 18 per hour depending on experience (approx. USD 1,040 to 1,560 per month at 20 hours/week), paid via Wise

- Long-term position, annual rate review

- Direct work with the founders and real influence on our creative process

- Paid subscription to all needed tools and software (Claude, Chat GPT, Figma etc.)





Hiring process



1. Application with portfolio (Amazon work only, max. 10 pieces, complete image sets)

2. Paid test task (approx. 4 to 6 hours): research a given product and its market. Based on your research, develop a concept / dramaturgy for the main image and 5 secondary images, create a new, optimized brand identity and design all 6 images with it.

3. Video call with the founders





How to apply

Start your application with the words “Concept First”. Applications without it will not be read.



Please answer:



1. Link a listing you designed that improved sales or conversion. What was the idea behind it, and how do you know it worked?

2. How would you brief a junior designer for one secondary image? (3 to 5 sentences)

3. Show one image where you used AI. What did you fix by hand to make it look real?

4. How many hours per week can you work now, and when could you go full-time?

5. Your expected hourly rate in USD.

**ABOUT US**



We are a Virginia-based real estate sales and coaching company serving agents across the US.



Our founder, Dan Rochon, is a TEDx speaker, host of the *No Broke Months* podcast, and author of *Teach to Sell*, published by Post Hill Press and distributed by Simon & Schuster.



Our work is built around one promise: helping real estate agents create **Consistent and Predictable Income — CPI**.



Dan has used this system since 2008 without having a broke month.



Today, the brand includes a book, podcast, coaching community, training, real estate sales organization, and agents producing meaningful results.



We already have the ideas.



We already have the stories.



We already have the content.



We need someone who can turn all of that into consistent attention.



**THE ROLE**



This is not a basic social media posting position.



You will help manage and grow the content engine behind the brand.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Managing content across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube,
, and LinkedIn.

* Prioritizing short form video and finding strong hooks, moments, and stories.

* Managing the *No Broke Months* podcast, including guest coordination, editing, publishing, show notes, and clips.

* Repurposing long form recordings into multiple pieces of content for different platforms.

* Supporting the marketing of *Teach to Sell*, including Amazon and Audible review campaigns.

* Identifying and sharing stories from our agents, including their wins, challenges, numbers, lessons, and transformations.

* Maintaining a reliable publishing calendar.

* Reviewing analytics and adjusting the content strategy based on actual performance.

* Providing a simple monthly report on reach, views, opt ins, applications, wins, misses, and next steps.



We do not need someone waiting for content assignments.



We need someone who sees the opportunity and moves.



**HOW WE WILL KNOW YOU ARE WINNING**



Content gets published consistently without someone asking for an update.



One strong recording turns into ten or more useful pieces of content.



Important clips do not sit untouched in folders.



You know which posts worked and which ones did not.



You can explain what the numbers are telling us.



You can look at last month's performance and confidently identify what should be repeated, improved, or stopped.



And the biggest sign of success:



The audience starts connecting with the people, stories, and results inside the community — not just the founder.



**YOU MAY BE A GREAT FIT IF**



* You have at least 2 years of experience managing social media, content, or digital marketing for a US or international brand.

* You can show us real accounts, channels, or campaigns you have worked on.

* You personally know how to edit short form video using CapCut, Premiere, Descript, or similar tools.

* You understand what makes someone stop scrolling and continue watching.

* You can write clear, natural English that does not sound generic or templated.

* You can manage deadlines and a content calendar without being constantly reminded.

* You are comfortable looking at analytics and making decisions from them.

* You can take a long interview, podcast, or training and quickly identify the strongest moments.

* You can work at least four hours overlapping with US Eastern Time.

* You have reliable internet and a backup option if your connection goes down.



**THIS PROBABLY IS NOT FOR YOU IF**



* You mainly want to design graphics and schedule posts.

* You need someone else to tell you what to publish every day.

* You have never edited short form video yourself.

* You rarely review performance after posting.

* You wait for detailed instructions before taking action.

* You regularly miss publishing deadlines.

* You dislike having your work measured.

* You believe posting more automatically means the marketing is working.



This role has clear expectations and clear numbers.



**OUR HIRING PROCESS**



We believe the work should speak louder than the resume.



Every application goes through the same initial review using the AI evaluation system our agents use, built around twenty years of top-producer sales experience.



Qualified candidates will then complete a short practical assessment.



That may include:



* Writing three different hooks for a video we provide.

* Reviewing a piece of content that underperformed and explaining what you would change.

* Building a simple 90 day strategy for one social media channel.

* Recording a 60–90 second video explaining a piece of content you are proud of and why you believe it performed well.



Candidates who perform well move into a **paid two week trial**.



We believe a real working trial tells both sides more than another round of interviews.



At the end, we should both know whether this is the right fit.



**HOW TO APPLY**



Send your application with the following information, in this order:



* **BLUEPRINT** as the first word.

* A link to your **portfolio** showing your best marketing, social media, video, or content work.

* Links to two or three social media accounts or channels you have managed, along with what you personally handled.

* Two examples of short form videos you edited yourself.

* Your expected monthly salary in USD.

* One sentence explaining the best performing piece of content you have created and why you believe it worked.



Applications that follow the instructions will be reviewed.



Applications that do not will not.

title: Real Time Review Specialist
description:
Position Summary

The Real-Time Review (RTR) Specialist is responsible for reviewing residential solar installation and inspection documentation in real time to verify accuracy, completeness, workmanship, and compliance with applicable requirements. This position serves as a critical quality checkpoint between field operations and inspection completion. The RTR Specialist works directly with field technicians and internal departments to identify deficiencies, communicate required corrections, and help prevent avoidable inspection failures, repeat visits, and project delays. The ideal candidate combines residential solar knowledge, technical judgment, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to communicate effectively in a fast-paced operational environment.



Core Responsibilities

Real-Time Inspection Review

- Review field-submitted photographs, inspection documentation, and installation details as they are received.

- Verify that documentation meets company standards and applicable inspection requirements.

- Identify missing photographs, incomplete documentation, installation deficiencies, and potential compliance issues.

- Provide clear, actionable feedback to field technicians while they are on-site.

- Verify that identified deficiencies have been appropriately addressed before closing the review.

- Maintain timely review turnaround to minimize field delays.



Technical Quality & Compliance

- Review residential solar PV installation components, including inverters, disconnects, electrical panels, conduit, labeling, grounding, and related equipment.

- Identify potential discrepancies between approved plans and installed equipment.

- Apply working knowledge of NEC requirements, AHJ standards, and company installation procedures.

- Recognize technical issues requiring additional review by qualified electrical or operational personnel.

- Document recurring installation or documentation deficiencies.



Field Communication & Coordination

- Communicate directly with field technicians regarding required photographs, corrections, and documentation.

- Coordinate with Inspection Scheduling, Permitting, ESC, Installation, and other operational departments.

- Escalate unresolved technical issues, inspection risks, and project delays to the appropriate leadership.

- Provide accurate status updates and maintain clear documentation of outstanding items.

- Support timely resolution of issues that could affect inspection readiness.



Documentation & Process Improvement

- Maintain accurate review records, correction notes, and completion statuses in company systems.

- Follow established review procedures and documentation standards.

- Identify recurring deficiencies and recommend improvements to field documentation and inspection readiness.

- Support consistency and accountability across inspection review processes.



Required Qualifications

- Experience in residential solar installation, inspection operations, quality control, or a closely related technical field.

- Working knowledge of residential solar PV systems and electrical installation components.

- Familiarity with applicable NEC requirements and AHJ inspection standards.

- Ability to interpret installation photographs, technical documentation, and approved plans.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to identify technical discrepancies.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to prioritize multiple active reviews in a time-sensitive environment.

- Sound judgment, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently.

- Proficiency with digital documentation, project management, and operational software.



Preferred Qualifications

- Previous experience in real-time solar inspection review.

- Experience supporting residential solar inspection technicians.

- Familiarity with solar permitting and inspection workflows.

- Experience identifying installation deficiencies and coordinating corrective actions.



Performance Expectations

- Accuracy and completeness of real-time reviews.

- Timely communication of deficiencies and required corrections.

- Consistent adherence to established review procedures.

- Quality and clarity of review documentation.

- Reduction of preventable inspection failures and repeat field visits.

- Effective coordination with field technicians and operational departments.

- Timely escalation of unresolved technical or compliance issues.

- Ability to maintain quality while managing multiple active reviews.



If you know residential solar, have an exceptional eye for detail, and aren't afraid to stop a project when something isn't right, we want to hear from you.



Apply Here:

title: Operations and Sales Director
description:
Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time



About the Role



We are looking for a highly motivated, organized, and experienced Director of Sales & Operations to join our team.



This is a hands-on, high-accountability position responsible for managing our seller and buyer leads from initial contact through the preparation of businesses for sale.



You will personally contact leads, book and conduct discovery calls, gather financial and business information, manage follow-up, coordinate documentation, and use our AI-powered systems to help prepare business valuations and Confidential Information Memorandums (CIMs).



This is NOT an entry-level position.



We are looking for someone who is confident speaking with business owners, understands sales, is relentless about follow-up, stays extremely organized, and can leverage technology and AI to move quickly and efficiently.



Schedule

Full-time

Monday–Friday

8:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time

Must be available and responsive during these hours

Core Responsibilities

Seller Lead Management



You will manage seller leads from their first inquiry through the initial stages of preparing their business for sale.



Responsibilities include:



Contact every new seller lead promptly.

Call, text, and follow up consistently until contact is made.

Schedule seller appointments.

Conduct initial discovery and qualification calls.

Ask detailed questions about the seller and their business.

Gather information regarding revenue, profit, expenses, employees, owner involvement, assets, leases, customers, growth opportunities, reason for selling, timeline, and other relevant information.

Request and collect financial statements and required documentation.

Keep sellers moving through the process.

Identify missing information and follow up until it is received.

Make sure no seller lead falls through the cracks.

Buyer Lead Management



You will also manage and qualify prospective buyers.



Responsibilities include:



Contact every buyer lead.

Schedule buyer appointments.

Conduct buyer qualification calls.

Evaluate buyer experience, financial ability, available cash, financing options, industry preferences, location preferences, acquisition criteria, and timeline.

Determine what type of business the buyer is looking to acquire.

Ensure NDAs and required documentation are completed before confidential information is released.

Match qualified buyers with appropriate listings.

Maintain consistent follow-up with active buyers.

Track buyers who may be a fit for future listings.

Maintain an organized database of qualified buyers and acquisition criteria.

Business Valuations



You will use our established systems and AI tools to assist in preparing business valuations.



Responsibilities include:



Review seller financial information.

Identify potential add-backs.

Calculate and review SDE and EBITDA when appropriate.

Research applicable industry multiples.

Use our AI systems to assist with valuation analysis.

Identify missing, inconsistent, or questionable financial information.

Prepare valuations for internal review.

Make sure the final valuation is logical, complete, accurate, and professional.



AI will do much of the heavy lifting, but you are responsible for the quality, accuracy, and completeness of the information being entered and reviewed.



CIM Preparation



You will use our AI systems to prepare Confidential Information Memorandums (CIMs) for businesses being marketed for sale.



This includes:



Gathering information from sellers.

Reviewing financial information.

Preparing company overviews.

Documenting products and services.

Identifying competitive advantages.

Outlining staffing and owner responsibilities.

Identifying growth opportunities.

Organizing financial information.

Reviewing AI-generated CIMs.

Correcting errors and missing information.

Improving the final document.

Following up with sellers when information is missing.



You are responsible for making sure every CIM is accurate, professional, complete, and ready to be presented to qualified buyers.



Sales & Operations



This position plays a critical role in managing the day-to-day operations surrounding our sales pipeline.



You will:



Maintain and update the CRM daily.

Track every buyer and seller lead.

Make sure every lead has a clear status and next action.

Track appointments and follow-ups.

Make sure required documents are collected.

Keep files and deal information organized.

Identify stalled leads and deals.

Coordinate with brokers, administrative staff, and management.

Make sure deadlines and next steps are completed.

Help improve systems, processes, and AI workflows.

Identify problems before they become bigger problems.

Keep management informed about pipeline activity and operational issues.

Take ownership of getting tasks completed without constant supervision.

Required Experience

This is NOT an entry-level position.



Applicants MUST have previous sales experience.



You should have experience with:



Calling and communicating with leads.

Qualifying prospects.

Booking appointments.

Conducting sales or discovery calls.

Following up with prospects.

Managing a sales pipeline.

Working inside a CRM or similar system.

Managing multiple prospects at different stages of a sales process.

Working toward measurable sales goals.



Experience in any of the following is a major plus:



Business brokerage

Real estate

B2B sales

Financial services

M&A

Business acquisitions

High-ticket sales

Consulting

Entrepreneurship



If you do not have previous sales experience, please do not apply.



Technology Requirements



You must be comfortable working in a technology-driven environment.



Required:



Must have an iPhone.

Must be comfortable calling and texting leads from an iPhone.

Must be comfortable using AI tools.

Must be comfortable working inside a CRM.

Must be able to learn new software and technology quickly.

Must be comfortable using multiple systems simultaneously.

Must be able to use technology to increase productivity and speed.

Who We're Looking For



The right person is:



Extremely organized

Confident and professional on the phone

Comfortable speaking with business owners

Persistent and consistent with follow-up

Motivated by results

Comfortable with sales

Detail-oriented

Comfortable working with numbers and financial information

Quick to learn new technology

Comfortable using AI

Able to manage multiple priorities

Independent and self-motivated

Solution-oriented

Accountable for results

Someone who takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do



You should be the type of person who sees a problem and thinks:



"How do I fix this?"



—not—



"Someone should tell me what to do."



How Success Will Be Measured



Your performance will be measured using clear activity and performance metrics, including:



Speed to lead

Percentage of leads contacted

Seller appointments booked

Buyer appointments booked

Appointment show rate

Seller conversion rate

Buyer qualification rate

Follow-up completion

Valuations completed

CIMs completed

Turnaround time

CRM accuracy

Qualified opportunities moved forward

Overall organization of the buyer and seller pipeline

The Bottom Line



Your job is to make sure nothing falls through the cracks.



Every seller lead gets contacted.



Every buyer lead gets contacted.



Every qualified prospect gets an appointment.



Every appointment gets followed up with.



Every qualified seller gets moved toward a valuation and CIM.



Every qualified buyer gets matched with the right opportunities.



You will use AI, automation, and technology to work faster, but you are ultimately responsible for making sure the work gets done correctly, completely, and on time.



If you are a strong salesperson who is highly organized, loves follow-up, is comfortable with technology and AI, and knows how to take ownership of a sales and operations pipeline, we want to hear from you.



To Apply



Please submit your resume and include a brief explanation of:



Your previous sales experience

Why you believe you are qualified for this position

Your experience using CRMs and technology

Your experience using AI tools

Your availability to work Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time

title: B2B Appointment Setter - Outbound Calls
description:
A company in the automotive software industry is hiring a full-time remote Appointment Setter to join a growing sales team. This is a high-activity, outbound calling role focused on reaching automotive dealership decision-makers and booking qualified software demonstrations. This is not a closing role. Your job is to get the right person on the phone, create interest, and schedule the demo.



If you are a confident, persistent cold caller with B2B or SaaS appointment-setting experience, we want to hear from you.



This is a fully remote position. You must be available to work during Central Time (CT) business hours.





ABOUT THE COMPANY



We are a lead nurturing software company serving the automotive industry, specifically new and used car dealerships. We have approximately 125 clients, a team of around 20 employees, and we are actively growing. We are building out our outbound sales process and looking for a high-caliber appointment setter to help us scale.





RESPONSIBILITIES



- Make a high volume of outbound calls daily to automotive dealerships across the United States

- Use a proven calling script to reach General Managers and other key decision-makers

- Navigate gatekeepers professionally and find the best path to reach the right person

- Focus on generating conversations and booking qualified software demos, not hard closing

- Send follow-up
s when decision-makers are unavailable and maintain consistent follow-up cadence

- Schedule qualified prospects for software demonstrations

- Track all calls, contacts, appointments, and outcomes accurately in the CRM every day

- Meet daily outreach and appointment-setting benchmarks

- Participate actively in ongoing training and coaching sessions

- Provide feedback on what is working and suggest ideas for improving the calling process

- Help build a scalable outbound appointment-setting system that can support additional team members over time

- Optimize your approach continuously based on what is producing the best results





QUALIFICATIONS



- Strong, clear, professional spoken English with a neutral or natural accent

- Proven experience in B2B appointment setting, cold calling, or outbound sales

- Experience in SaaS, AI, software, or technology sales is strongly preferred

- Automotive industry or dealership experience is a plus

- Comfortable speaking confidently with business owners, General Managers, and senior decision-makers

- Persistent, resilient, and able to handle rejection without losing motivation

- Highly organized with strong attention to detail and excellent follow-up habits

- Comfortable working with a CRM or lead tracking system

- Able to learn and work with the company's proprietary lead nurturing and demo software

- Familiarity with AI tools and SaaS platforms is preferred

- Coachable and willing to follow a proven script while also contributing ideas for improvement

- Results-driven and motivated by measurable, trackable performance

- Able to work independently and maintain full productivity throughout an 8-hour calling shift

- Must be available full-time, 40 hours per week, on a Central Time schedule





PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



The primary goal of this role is qualified appointments booked, not just calls made. The initial benchmark is approximately 1 qualified demo per day during an 8-hour shift. As the process is refined and scaled, the long-term goal is 6 to 10 demos per day. Performance will be closely monitored and there is potential for performance-based bonuses tied to successful closes. There is also the possibility of a second VA being added as volume grows and results are proven.





IMPORTANT



This is a high-volume, outbound cold-calling role. You will be on the phone most of the day, every day. If you are not comfortable with that level of calling activity, this is not the right fit. Candidates with general VA or customer service experience only will not be prioritized. We are specifically looking for someone with demonstrated B2B cold-calling, appointment-setting, SaaS, or AI sales experience.





SCHEDULE



Full-time, 40 hours per week

Central Time (CT) business hours

Start date: October 1, 2026, or sooner





HOW TO APPLY



To be considered for this role, please submit the following:



- Updated Resume

- Introduction Audio (Vacaroo is fine)



Applications without both items will not be reviewed. We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Short Form Video Editor
description:
A company in the South Asian luxury fashion industry is looking for a creative and story-driven short-form video editor to join the team. This is a remote, part-time role working closely with a NYC-based founder and designer. If you have a strong creative instinct, a cinematic eye, and a deep understanding of what makes short-form content stop a scroll, we want to hear from you.



This is not a generic influencer editing role. We are looking for someone who understands pacing, emotion, sound, and framing, and who can transform simple, low-fi footage into something that feels elevated and intentional. The aesthetic we are going for is cinematic, feminine, whimsical, emotional, and occasionally intense. Think the contrast between calm visuals and sharp pacing, between ordinary footage and unexpected creative decisions, between chaos and sudden stillness.



Creative instinct matters more than technical complexity here.





RESPONSIBILITIES

- Create cinematic, Gen Z-style edits that prioritize storytelling over polish

- Apply creative typography, framing, zooms, transitions, and pacing to elevate footage

- Build strong sound design using music, silence, effects, and precise audio cuts

- Source additional footage when needed to complete the story

QUALIFICATIONS



- Proven experience editing short-form video content, particularly for TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts

- A portfolio that demonstrates strong storytelling, pacing, and aesthetic sensibility

- Ability to work with simple, unpolished iPhone footage and elevate it through editing choices

- Strong understanding of sound design and how audio shapes emotion and rhythm

- Familiarity with the Gen Z / TikTok visual language without defaulting to generic trends

- Ability to take creative ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do

- Experience in fashion, lifestyle, or luxury content is a strong plus

- Comfortable working remotely and independently on a consistent weekly schedule

- Reliable communication and ability to meet turnaround expectations





WHAT WE PROVIDE



- Scripts and voiceover

- Music selections

You will handle everything from there, including editing, sound design, text, framing, colour grading, pacing, and sourcing any additional footage needed.





SCHEDULE

title: Senior Serviced Accommodation VA
description:
Senior Serviced Accommodation VA (Uplisting, SuiteOp, Turno) UK Property Management



Full time, long term (this is not a project or a trial gig)



SALARY



?40,000 to ?50,000 per month, depending on experience and how well you know our systems.



We pay above market because we expect above market. If you are a general admin VA looking to learn serviced accommodation, this is not your role. If you have run a UK or US short let portfolio before and can prove it, we want to hear from you.



HOURS



Shift based, aligned to UK time. Our operation runs 7am to 11pm UK time, 7 days a week, and we cover it with a rotating shift pattern. You will work 8 hours per day, 5 days per week, with a fixed schedule agreed in advance and a weekend rotation shared across the team.



Your shift will fall inside UK daytime and evening hours. Please only apply if you are genuinely happy working to UK time long term.



ABOUT US



Valstays is a UK serviced accommodation and Airbnb management company. We manage properties across the whole of the UK. We work with landlords, property investors and developers, and we run both a full management model and our own rent to rent portfolio.



We are a small, fast moving team. Our VAs are not order takers, they run the day to day operation. You will work directly with our team lead and our founders, and you will have real ownership of your shift.



WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING



Guest communication



Handling all guest messages across Airbnb, 
, Vrbo and direct enquiries during your shift

Responding fast, in clear written English, in our brand tone

Managing check in and check out communication, access instructions and troubleshooting

Resolving complaints and issues calmly before they become reviews

Converting OTA guests to direct bookings using our SOP



Bookings and revenue



Processing enquiries, quoting, and confirming bookings

Managing extensions, amendments, cancellations and relocations

Handling deposits and damage waivers through our system

Flagging pricing and availability issues



Cleaning and turnovers



Scheduling and monitoring cleans in Turno

Chasing cleaners, confirming completion, checking photo evidence

Rebooking and escalating failed or late cleans so no guest ever walks into a dirty property

Managing linen and consumables stock alerts



Maintenance



Logging and triaging maintenance issues

Coordinating contractors, booking access, chasing completion

Keeping the owner or landlord informed where relevant



Admin and systems



Keeping property data, listings and SOPs accurate in Notion

Completing a written end of shift handover for the incoming VA every single day

Flagging broken automations and process gaps rather than working around them

TECH STACK



You must have hands on experience with at least three of these:



Uplisting (or a comparable PMS such as Hostaway, Guesty or Hospitable)

SuiteOp

Turno (or Properly / Breezeway)

Notion

Slack

Airbnb, 
 and Vrbo host dashboards



Bonus if you have used:



Zapier

Brevo

PriceLabs or Wheelhouse

Stripe



Tell us honestly what you have used and for how long. We will test it.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

2 or more years working in short term rentals or serviced accommodation, ideally for a UK or US portfolio

Excellent written English. Our guests are UK based professionals, contractors and families, and your messages represent our brand

Genuinely fast. Guest response time matters more here than almost anything else

Calm under pressure. A failed clean at 4pm on a Friday should make you move, not freeze

Proactive. You spot the problem before it lands in the inbox

Reliable internet, backup connection, and a quiet place to work

Comfortable being measured on numbers: response time, review scores, turnover failures

THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF

You are juggling multiple clients and this would be one of several

You need someone to tell you what to do every hour

You have done general admin or social media VA work and want to move into property

You cannot commit to UK hours long term

You wait to be asked before flagging something that has gone wrong

WHAT WE OFFER

Long term, stable, full time role with a growing company

Weekly pay 

Paid time off (with suitable notice before hand)

Clear SOPs and systems that actually work

Real progression

A team that does not micromanage but does expect standards

HOW TO APPLY



Applications that do not follow these instructions will be deleted without reading. This is the first test.



1. Put this exactly as your subject line: VALSTAYS SA VA 2026



2. In your application, answer these four questions directly. Short answers are fine, we are looking for clarity not essays.



Which property management system have you used, for how long, and how many units were you managing?

List every tool from our tech stack above that you have used, with a rating of 1 to 5 for each.

A guest is due to check in at 8pm. At 6pm the cleaner messages to say she cannot get into the property. Tell us exactly what you do, in order, in the next two hours.

What are your salary expectations in PHP per month, and what UK hours can you commit to?



3. Record a 2 minute video or voice recording introducing yourself and telling us about the most difficult guest situation you have handled and how it ended. Send us the link.



4. Tell us your fastest available start date and your notice period.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
description:
The Company:



This search is being conducted on behalf of Accordant Capital, a Chicago-based family office and growth investment firm. Accordant was named to reflect the firm's commitment to alignment and partnership with entrepreneurs, emphasizing congruency between the goals of operators and the resources the firm provides. Accordant partners with growth-oriented entrepreneurs and CEOs who are seeking more than capital. The firm provides access to leadership talent, growth expertise, and a proven services playbook that enables founders to focus on what they do best — serving their markets in new and innovative ways. Because Accordant rarely raises outside capital, it can focus entirely on aligning its expertise and investment horizon with the needs of its operating companies. 



Accordant has a long history of success in multiple industries. Its largest operating platform is MPHQ, serving the $30 billion healthcare compliance market, including market-leading brands MedPro Waste Disposal, HazPro Waste Disposal, and MP1 Solutions. MPHQ provides a growing suite of innovative services including regulated medical waste disposal, OSHA workplace safety, HIPAA certification, HR compliance training, pharmaceutical waste management, and secure document destruction to over 30,000 clients nationwide. 



In addition to MPHQ, Accordant's diverse and growing operating company portfolio includes Mend Strategies, Modern Amenities, AIMS Group, and Break Through Closing — each reflecting the firm's approach of partnering with founders to scale businesses through strategic growth, operational excellence, and talent development. 



Position Overview:

The SDR is a full-cycle sales role responsible for opening new doors for MPHQ — Accordant Capital's healthcare compliance platform — and converting outbound conversations into qualified opportunities and closed business. You will prospect into US provider offices, navigate to decision-makers, understand their compliance needs, position the Company's value, handle objections, and close business. 



Success means consistent activity, strong conversion, disciplined pipeline management, and month-over-month quota attainment. You are a seller, not a script reader — comfortable creating conversations from cold outreach, asking strong discovery questions, listening before recommending, handling rejection, and asking for the close. 



Key Responsibilities:



Outbound Prospecting

• Make high-volume outbound calls into assigned US provider-office lists using targeted data and approved calling cadences. 

• Navigate gatekeepers and reach office managers, practice administrators, owners, and other decision-makers professionally. 

• Execute multi-touch outreach across calls and approved sales-engagement channels so viable accounts are not abandoned after a single attempt. 

• Prioritize accounts and activities based on ICP, likelihood to engage, and pipeline potential. 



Consultative Selling

• Open calls as conversations, not pitches, and earn the prospect's attention through relevant questions. 

• Understand how the practice manages compliance today, who they use, what it costs, and where the pain points are. 

• Translate compliance and waste requirements into clear, practical language for busy healthcare decision-makers. 

• Recommend solutions based on the prospect's needs and be transparent when Accordant is not the right fit. 

• Build relationships that create future opportunities even when the initial answer is no. 



Selling & Closing

• Position Accordant Capital, MedPro & MP1 Solutions around cost savings, compliance coverage, and service reliability based on what matters to the prospect. 

• Handle price, incumbent-vendor, timing, and other objections without unnecessarily discounting value. 

• Present promotional and incentive-based offers accurately and consistently. 

• Carry qualified opportunities through the full sales cycle to signed agreement, escalating larger or more complex deals according to the defined path. 

• Meet or exceed monthly targets for qualified opportunities, net-new customers, and revenue. 



Pipeline & CRM Discipline

• Respond to inbound leads quickly and qualify them against agreed criteria when assigned. 

• Keep accounts, contacts, activities, opportunities, and next steps current in the CRM the same day. 

• Own and prioritize your pipeline based on likelihood to close and expected value. 

• Complete follow-up according to the defined cadence and maintain accurate opportunity stages and close dates. 



Coaching & Team Contribution

• Participate fully in team huddles, call coaching, role plays, and call reviews. 

• Apply coaching feedback immediately and demonstrate measurable improvement. 

• Share effective discovery questions, objection responses, talk tracks, and prospect insights with the team. 

• Represent Accordant Capital professionally in every customer interaction and support occasional client-facing events or networking activities as needed. 



Required Qualifications:

• 2+ years in outbound B2B sales or another quota-carrying, phone-based sales role. 

• Demonstrated success with high-volume outbound cold calling and net-new account acquisition. 

• Demonstrated closing experience — not solely appointment setting or lead qualification. 

• Comfort with consultative selling: asks strong questions, listens actively, diagnoses needs, and recommends appropriately. 

• Strong spoken and written English with a warm, confident, professional phone presence for a US audience. 

• Experience using a CRM and sales-engagement or sequencing tools; Salesforce, HubSpot, or GoHighLevel experience preferred. 

• Comfort with dialers and call-recording/coaching tools such as Gong or equivalent. 

• Resilience, coachability, and ability to perform consistently in a rejection-heavy, quota-driven environment. 

• Ability to maintain full overlap with US business hours (CST). 



Nice-to-Have:

• Experience selling into US non-acute healthcare practices — physician, dental, long-term care, veterinary, or similar. 

• Experience selling compliance, medical waste, insurance, SaaS, BPO, or other recurring B2B services. 

• Experience with Salesforce, GoHighLevel, Gong, or comparable sales technology. 

• Experience working under tiered incentive or commission plans. 

• Existing familiarity with US healthcare practice management or compliance environments. 



Compensation & Benefits:

• Base pay starts at $1000/month based on experience

• Plus potential performance incentives tied to qualified opportunities generated and new customers closed. Incentives are discretionary and may be provided, adjusted, or removed by the Company as it deems necessary; details will be stated in the employment contract. 

• Full-time, permanent work-from-home. 

• Monday–Friday, full overlap with US business hours (CST) to align with US provider-office calling windows. 

• Work Anniversary Bonus

• No work with pay on US Holidays



Basic Technical Requirements:

• Reliable remote work setup with a stable, high-speed internet connection.

• Noise-canceling headset for a professional, US-facing phone presence.

• Backup power and backup internet connection.

• A quiet and dedicated workspace at home.

• Ability to maintain full overlap with US business hours (CST).



Application Process:

1. Record a 1–2-minute video introduction using Loom or Vocaroo and share the link with us for easy access.



In your video, please briefly introduce yourself and answer the following: 

• What is your outbound sales/cold-calling experience? Please include your years of experience and the type of roles you've handled (e.g., SDR, BDR, telesales, appointment setting, full-cycle closing). 



• Have you carried and consistently met a sales quota? Briefly share the quota structure and your typical attainment. 



• How many years have you worked in a work-from-home/remote setup supporting a US-based team or US clients? 



• Are you currently employed or working under a contract? If yes, please briefly share your current work arrangement and availability. 



3. Please email the following to 

Use the following subject line: [Your Full Name] – SDR – Remote



Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:

Accordant Capital and its portfolio companies, including MedPro Disposal and MP1 Solutions, are equal opportunity employers. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Crypto BD Lead Wanted: Turn DeFi Contacts Into Booked Calls, Get Paid Per Call + Overrides
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

title: Growth-Minded Virtual Assistant | Part-Time, Remote | 8-Figure Modest Fashion Brand
description:
ABOUT OUR BRAND



We are an 8-figure modest fashion brand serving women across the US, UK, UAE, Singapore, and Saudi Arabia. We make hijabs, abayas, and modest essentials that make daily modest living easier, with less adjusting and less overthinking.



Our mission is simple: modesty should support a woman's life, not constantly fight it.



We're a small team. There's no big hierarchy and no "that's not my department." We help each other, learn together, and win together. The work you do here directly affects thousands of customers every month.





THE ROLE



This is not a typical VA job, and it's not for someone who wants to clock in, and clock out.



We're a small team of jack-of-all-trades. One day it's customer
s, the next it's a Shopify fix, a new tool, a product launch, or a problem nobody has solved before. New things come up all the time, and we figure them out together. You need to adapt fast, learn fast, and enjoy it.



What matters most is how you think:



- You think ahead. You see the problem before it happens and the next step before anyone asks.

- You work with structure. Your day is planned, your work is organized, and your messages are clear.

- You always want to be better. You look for mistakes (including your own), fix them, and improve the process.

- You're a great collaborator. You help teammates, communicate clearly, and take feedback well.

- You're committed. You care about the results, not just the hours. You want to grow with us long-term.



If that sounds like you, keep reading.





WHERE YOU'LL START



Customer Experience

- Reply to customer
s warmly, accurately, and in our brand voice

- Solve the issue in one reply whenever possible, instead of just answering

- Follow our SOPs, and use good judgment when a case doesn't fit the script

- Track every open case until it is fully resolved



Shopify & Admin Tasks

- Handle daily Shopify admin: orders, edits, product listings, product info

- Keep sheets, trackers, and documents clean and up to date

- Spot recurring problems and propose a fix



Basic SEO

- Optimize product titles, descriptions, and meta data

- Do basic keyword research for products and collections



And then, whatever the business needs next

- Learn new tools, systems, and processes as we grow

- Support new projects, launches, and areas of the business

- Jump in wherever the team needs a hand



This list will grow, and the right person will grow with it.





WHAT YOU'LL DELIVER (how we measure success)



- All customer
s handled within your shift, with no backlog left behind

- Zero missed follow-ups: every open case has a status and a next step

- Your day is planned before it starts, and your tasks are finished, not just started

- You catch mistakes and issues before they reach a customer or a teammate

- At least one improvement idea per week, such as a better process, a template, or a fix

- New tasks and tools are picked up quickly, without needing to be taught twice





WHAT YOU BRING



- Excellent written English that is warm, clear, and professional

- Experience in customer support, Shopify, or e-commerce (a plus, not a must if you learn fast)

- Basic understanding of SEO

- Comfortable with Google Sheets, Gmail, Google Calendar, and AI tools

- Curiosity: you enjoy figuring out things you've never done before





THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF:



- You only want to do the tasks listed in your job description

- You need step-by-step instructions for everything

- You take feedback personally instead of using it

- You wait to be reminded or chased

- You just clock in, do the minimum, and clock out

- You're happy doing the same level of work a year from now





OUR CORE VALUES



These are not words on a wall. We hire, give feedback, and grow people based on them. The right person will read these and think, "That's me."



1. Structure is King

Before you act, communicate, or solve, you structure it. Your day is planned before it starts. Your messages have a clear point. When something goes wrong, you respond with order, not panic.

"If it is not structured, it does not exist."



2. Volume Negates Luck

We improve through repetition, not perfection. Every task is a chance to get better, every mistake is information, and every piece of feedback is a gift. You always ask, "How can I do this better next time?"

"We don't win because of luck. We win because of volume, reflection, and the willingness to always improve."



3. Take Ownership

When something goes wrong, look inward first. When something needs to be done, don't wait to be told. You follow through until a task is fully resolved, and you never say "that's not my job." No blaming and no finger-pointing: everyone is part of the solution.

"Problems belong to the team, not to one person."



4. Speed is a Weapon

Speed is not rushing. It is removing delay, wasted steps, and overthinking. If something can be done today, it is done today. Doing something twice because it was rushed is not speed; it is waste.

"Speed is not about doing everything faster. It is about doing everything without unnecessary delay."



5. One Step Ahead

Proactive is our default. You flag issues before they become problems. You think about what the customer and the team need before they have to say it. You come with a suggestion, not just an update.





SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION



- 4 hours/day, Wednesday to Sunday (about 20 hours/week)

- Starting at $200/month, negotiable

- We value results over hours. When your work is done well and early, the remaining time is yours. You just stay contactable during your shift.



How you grow with us:

We reward impact, not time served. When you prove you bring more value, through consistent improvement, a strong attitude, and real alignment with our values, you earn:

- Better compensation

- A bigger role and more responsibility in the team

- More trust and more ownership over important work



We're building this team for the long term, and we want people who grow with it.





WHY JOIN US



- Work inside a fast-growing 8-figure e-commerce brand

- Fully remote and flexible

- A small, supportive team where everyone helps each other

- Learn real e-commerce from the inside: customer experience, Shopify, SEO, operations, and more

- Honest feedback that actually makes you better

- Your growth depends on your impact, not on how long you've been here





HOW TO APPLY



We read every application. To show us you read this post carefully:



1. Start your proposal with the words "One step ahead"

2. Tell us about a time you received hard feedback: what it was and what you changed

3. Tell us about a time you spotted a problem before anyone else and fixed it without being asked

4. Tell us about something new you had to learn fast, and how you did it



Generic or copy-paste proposals will not be considered.

title: Experienced Service Accommodation VA
description:
We manage a portfolio of serviced accommodation properties across the UK including Manchester, Liverpool, Leeds, Birmingham, Sheffield, Nottingham, and London. We operate a mix of fully managed and rent-to-rent properties listed on Airbnb, 
, and direct booking channels.



We are hiring an experienced VA to join our operations team. This is not an entry-level role. We are looking for someone who has worked in serviced accommodation or short-term rentals before and can handle guest messaging, cleaning coordination, and maintenance management without needing to be trained on the basics.



What you will be doing:



Guest communication across Airbnb, 
, and direct channels, from booking confirmation through to post-checkout review requests. You will handle complaints, enquiries, early check-in and late checkout requests, and anything else that comes up during a guest's stay.



Cleaning and turnover coordination through Turno, making sure every property is guest-ready before each check-in. That means scheduling cleans, checking post-clean photos, chasing cleaners who haven't confirmed, and finding replacements when someone cancels.



Maintenance logging and coordination. When a guest reports a problem, you contact the contractor, keep the guest updated, and follow up until it is resolved. You do not just log it and move on.



Listing and calendar management inside Uplisting, our PMS and channel manager.



Team communication through Slack and task management through Notion.



You'll also be given time filler tasks for quiet hours, listing creation & optimisation, sourcing new cleaners & maintenance, updating SOPs, and just general help



Our tech stack:



Uplisting, SuiteOp, Turno, Notion, Slack, Zapier, Brevo, PriceLabs, Airbnb, 



You do not need to have used every one of these, but you should recognise most of them and have hands-on experience with comparable tools. If you have never used a PMS or channel manager before, this role is not the right fit.



What we are looking for:



At least 2 years of experience in serviced accommodation, short-term rentals, or holiday let operations. We want someone who has actually managed guest communications and property operations day to day, not someone who has done general VA work and is looking to move into SA for the first time.



Strong written English. Your guest messages need to be warm, professional, and natural. Robotic or templated communication will not work for us.



Calm under pressure. Things go wrong in this job. Guests get locked out, cleaners cancel, boilers break. We need someone whose instinct is to solve it, not panic or wait to be told what to do.



Reliable internet, backup power, and a quiet working environment.



Schedule:



9:00 AM to 5:00 PM UK time, 5 days per week. This shift overlaps with our existing VA team. Willingness to work weekends and public holidays is essential, not optional.



Rate:



£2.61 per hour. This is a long-term, full-time position with a team that is growing. We are not looking for someone for three months. If you are looking for something stable where you can develop, this is it.



To apply:



Send us a message with the following:



A summary of your SA or short-let experience, including which companies you have worked for, how many properties you supported, and which platforms and PMS tools you used.



Your availability and whether you have any other current roles.



A link to your CV.

We manage residential rentals in Illinois and need a detail-oriented coordinator to fill vacancies with qualified tenants. You will run listings, screen applicants against written criteria, and schedule tours with our on-site maintenance tech, who gives the showings.

Screening Workflow (you will follow this exactly)

Post: List on

Tour: Book qualified leads with the maintenance tech through the shared calendar / whatsapp. Confirm 24 hours ahead.

Verify: Confirm income (pay stubs or offer letter), employment by phone, and contact the previous two landlords.

Credit reports and SSNs stay inside the screening platform only.
