title: Appointment Setter - Australian Health Clinics (Warm Leads, No Cold Calling)
description:
We work with health clinics in Australia - physiotherapy, chiropractic and osteopathy.



People see our clients' ads on Facebook and Instagram and fill in a short form asking about an appointment. Your job is to call that person within 5 minutes and book them into the clinic's calendar.



These are warm leads. Everyone you call has already asked to be contacted. This is not cold calling.



FULL JOB DETAILS

Read the complete description here before applying:

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MUPwzzCC6DOuTk8iwiOu31tyD8iisZ3W2oW1UTJI6x0/view



It covers the hours, pay, what we expect, and the rules you must follow. Please read it properly - a lot of your questions are answered there.



HOURS

Monday to Friday, 7:00am to 7:00pm Manila time (9:00am to 9:00pm Sydney time). From October to April it becomes 6:00am to 6:00pm Manila time.



This is NOT 12 hours of non-stop calling. You need to be reachable across that window so any new lead gets called within 5 minutes. There are quiet stretches, and once your follow-up calls are done your time is your own.



PAY

AUD $750 per month base, plus AUD $5 for every appointment you book and AUD $3 more when that person shows up. Paid monthly through Wise. Independent contractor. Reviewed after 60 days, and it can go up as we add more clinics.



THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THIS JOB

Calling every new lead within 5 minutes. We can teach you everything else. If a lead comes in at 2:14pm, we want your first call logged by 2:19pm. Someone great on the phone but slow to call new leads is not a fit. Someone only okay on the phone who never misses the 5-minute window will do well here.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Call every new lead within 5 minutes. No answer: call again, leave a vocemail, send a text.

- Work the follow-up schedule - twice daily in week one, once daily to day 30, then weekly.

- Ask a few short questions, then book them into the clinic's calendar.

- Log every call, text and result in our CRM (GoHighLevel - we train you on it).

- Hand over once they are booked. The clinic's front desk looks after them from there.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Clear, easy-to-understand spoken English and a friendly phone manner.

- Available across the full window, Monday to Friday.

- Phone experience: appointment setting, inside sales or customer service.

- Reliable internet with a backup connection, plus backup power.

- A good headset and a quiet place to work.

- Someone who takes coaching well. We review recorded calls together and give direct feedback.



PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

Our clients are registered health professionals, and Australia has strict rules about what can be said about healthcare. You must never give medical advice, never tell someone what is wrong with them or what is causing it, and never promise they will get better. Anything medical goes to the practitioner. You will follow the script we give you. If that sounds like a problem, this is not the right job for you, and that is completely fine.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply only through this form:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfBq0Ion1HPKeytCaaNVM4cHS37ZobTx-zzcFYfXrBgIT6tgA/viewform



It includes a voice recording under 90 seconds. We do not review applications without it.



Please do not reply here with your CV - use the form.

This is a performance-based role with long-term growth opportunities for designers who can consistently create strong, trend-driven designs that convert into sales. We are looking for someone who can combine fashion taste, AI design skills, speed, accuracy, and commercial thinking to help us develop products customers are excited to buy.

Strong verbal and written English communication skills.

title: Real Estate Lead Manager / Cold Caller (Wholesaling) - Full-Time, U.S. Hours
description:
ABOUT US

Smith Asset Group LLC is a growing real estate wholesaling company based in Georgia, expanding into new markets across the U.S. We buy distressed and off-market properties directly from homeowners. We are building an ELITE acquisitions team and only want top performers who want to grow into a long-term leadership role with us.



THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL JOB. If you have never cold called U.S. homeowners for a real estate wholesaler, please do not apply.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Cold call and text homeowners from our distressed lead lists (code violations, pre-foreclosures, tax delinquent, inherited properties)

- Skip trace lists in DealMachine and scrub them against the Do Not Call list before dialing

- Qualify sellers on motivation, condition, timeline and asking price

- Handle objections with confidence and keep sellers on the phone

- Follow up with warm leads relentlessly and recycle no-answers

- Log every call and note in ReSimpli CRM, accurately and the same day

- Send hot leads to the owner immediately

- Send a daily end-of-shift report: dials, conversations, qualified leads, appointments



WHAT ELITE LOOKS LIKE HERE

- 2+ years of real estate cold calling for a U.S. wholesaler or investor

- Proven numbers you can show us (past KPIs, screenshots or a reference from a past U.S. real estate employer)

- Excellent spoken English with clear, confident, natural tone

- Strong objection handling. You don't fold when a seller says "not interested"

- Experience with power dialers and skip tracing tools (DealMachine, PropStream, BatchLeads or similar)

- Experience with a real estate CRM (ReSimpli, Podio, REI BlackBook or similar)

- Fast, stable internet PLUS a backup internet source and backup power

- Quiet home office and a quality noise-cancelling headset

- Available full-time on U.S. Eastern hours, Monday-Friday

- Coachable, reliable and hungry to grow



PAY

- $6-$7/hour, depending on experience

- $15 bonus for every qualified appointment that shows

- $200 bonus for every deal that closes

- Paid weekly

- Performance raises every 6 months, with a path to a senior lead manager role



HIRING PROCESS

1. Written application (questions below)

2. Recorded voice test

3. Live mock call with the owner

4. 1-week paid trial with real targets



TO APPLY, ANSWER ALL OF THESE:

1. How many years have you cold called for U.S. real estate wholesalers or investors? Name the type of company and your role.

2. What were your average daily dials, conversations and weekly qualified appointments at your last real estate job?

3. Which dialers, skip tracing tools and CRMs have you used?

4. Describe your backup internet and backup power setup.

5. Record a 2-3 minute voice clip: (a) introduce yourself as if calling a homeowner about buying their house, and (b) show how you'd respond when the seller says "I'm not interested" and "Your offer is way too low." Send the link.

6. Type the word "AUGUSTA" at the top of your application so we know you read the whole post.



Applications that skip any question will not be reviewed.
